title: Harry Kane scores goal by winning Golden Shoe for the second time
english: Harry Kane has earned the prestigious European Golden Shoe award for the second time in his professional career. The Bayern Munich forward secured the title by outperforming other elite strikers, including Erling Haaland and Kylian Mbappé. This recognition highlights his exceptional scoring performance during the season.
amharic: የባየር ሙኒክ አጥቂ ሃሪ ኬን በሙያዊ ህይወቱ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የአውሮፓ ምርጥ ግብ አስቆጣሪ በመባል የጎልደን ሹ ሽልማትን አሸንፏል። የእንግሊዝ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አጥቂው እንደ ኤርሊንግ ሃላንድ እና ኪሊያን ምባፔ ካሉ ታላላቅ ተጫዋቾች በልጦ በመገኘት ይህንን ክብር ተጎናጽፏል። ይህም የውድድር ዘመኑን አስደናቂ የግል ብቃቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hiri Keeniin miila isaanii kan Baayer Muuniik taphatu, badhaasa 'Goliden Shuu' kan warra Awurooppaa keessatti goliin hedduu galcheef kennamu yeroo lammaffaaf injifateera. Keeniin taphattoota beekamoo akka Erling Haalaandiifi Kiliyaan Embaappee caaluun badhaasa kana fudhateera. Injifannoon kun raawwii isaanii kan yeroo darbe keessatti dandeettii goliin galchuun qaban kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Nigeria’s election campaign begins with Tinubu facing a reform test
english: As Nigeria enters its 2027 election campaign cycle, President Bola Tinubu faces significant pressure due to a difficult economic climate characterized by rising costs of living. While his administration claims that unpopular reforms like ending fuel subsidies are essential for long-term stability, many citizens are struggling with decreased purchasing power. The upcoming race will likely be influenced by these economic hardships alongside political fragmentation among the opposition.
amharic: ናይጄሪያ የ2027 ምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ስትጀምር፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ቦላ ቲኑቡ በኑሮ ውድነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። መንግስት የነዳጅ ድጎማን ጨምሮ ያደረጋቸው የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያዎች ለረጅም ጊዜ ዘላቂ ጥቅም እንዳላቸው ቢገልጹም፣ አብዛኞቹ ዜጎች በአሁኑ ወቅት የገንዘብ አቅም ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። የመጪው ምርጫ ውጤትም በነዚህ የኢኮኖሚ ጫናዎች እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል ባለው መከፋፈል የሚወሰን ይሆናል።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaan gara sagantaa filannoo bara 2027 yommuu seentutti, pirezidaant Bola Tiinuubun baasii jireenyaa olka’eefii rakkoo dinagdee mudateen walqabatee mormii cimaan isaan mudateera. Mootummaan jijjiirama dinagdee garagaraa, kanneen akka gargaarsa boba’aa dhaabuu, bu’aa yeroo dheeraa qabu jedhee kan amanu ta’us, lammiileen hedduun jireenya guyyuu keessatti rakkoo dinagdee cimaa keessa jiru. Filannoon dhufu kunis dhiibbaa dinagdee kanaafi garee mormituu gidduutti walitti bu’iinsa jiruun kan murtaa’u ta’a.

title: Iran war live: Trump announces ‘most crushing’ Iran sanctions
english: President Donald Trump has declared the implementation of severe new economic sanctions against Iran following the collapse of negotiations between the two nations. The United States has warned that any country that assists Iran financially will face harsh penalties. Despite this escalation, Trump indicated that future talks remain a possibility, provided that Iran commits to stopping its nuclear weapons program.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል የተደረገው ድርድር ባለመሳካቱ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ የሆነ አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ለኢራን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚያደርግ ማንኛውም አካል ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድበት አስጠንቅቃለች። ይሁን እንጂ ትራምፕ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራሟን እስካቆመች ድረስ ለወደፊቱ ድርድር የመቀጠል እድል እንዳለ ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp mariin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa ture fashalaachuu hordofee, Iran irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan fudhatamuu beeksisaniiru. Ameerikaan biyyi kamiyyuu Iran gargaarsa maallaqaa yoo goote, adabbii cimaan akka irratti fudhatamu akeekkachiisteetti. Ta'us, Tiraamp Iran sagantaa meeshaa niwukilaraa ishee yoo dhaabde, gara fuulduraatti mariin itti fufuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru.

title: US national debt passes record $40 trillion
english: The United States national debt has officially exceeded $40 trillion, effectively doubling over the past decade. This significant rise is attributed to heavy government borrowing during the COVID-19 pandemic and extensive spending on infrastructure and social programs under both the Trump and Biden administrations. Experts warn that this growing debt burden threatens long-term economic stability and increases the cost of living for American citizens.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ዕዳ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ 40 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በማለፍ ባለፉት አስር ዓመታት ውስጥ በእጥፍ አድጓል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ዕድገት የተከሰተው በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ ወቅት በተደረገው ከፍተኛ የወጪ መተግበር እና በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና ባይደን አስተዳደሮች በተከናወኑ የመሠረተ ልማት እና ሌሎች ፕሮጀክቶች ምክንያት ነው። የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ይህ እያደገ የመጣ የዕዳ መጠን ለሀገሪቱ የረዥም ጊዜ ኢኮኖሚያዊ መረጋጋት ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር እና የኑሮ ውድነትን እንደሚጨምር አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Hiriin biyyaalessaa kan Ameerikaa yeroo jalqabaaf dolaara tiriliyoona 40 kan darbe yoo ta'u, kurnan waggoota darban keessatti dachaan dabaleera. Daballiin guddaan kun dhukkuba kovid-19 yeroo turetti baasii mootummaan godhe, akkasumas sirna Trump fi Biden jalatti piroojektiiwwan misoomaa fi kanneen biroo irratti baasii guddaa baasuun kan dhufe dha. Hayyoonni dinagdee akka jedhanitti, hiriin kun guddachaa deemun isaa nageenya dinagdee biyyattii irratti balaa kan qabuufi gatiin jireenyaa akka dabalu gochuu isaa akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: ‘We do not trust Israeli judiciary’ says Hind Rajab’s grandmother
english: The grandmother of five-year-old Hind Rajab, who was killed alongside six relatives by Israeli forces in Gaza earlier this year, has rejected the credibility of an Israeli criminal investigation into the incident. She stated that she has no faith in the Israeli judicial system to provide justice for her granddaughter’s death. The family remains deeply skeptical of any official inquiry conducted by the same forces responsible for the tragedy.
amharic: በጋዛ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች ከተገደለችው የአምስት ዓመቷ ሂንድ ራጃብ አያት፣ የእስራኤል መንግሥት በልጅ ልጇ ሞት ላይ የጀመረውን የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደማትቀበለው ገለጹ። አያቷ የእስራኤል የፍትህ ስርዓት ፍትህን ይሰጣል ብለው እንደማያምኑ ተናግረዋል። ቤተሰቡ በግድያው ተጠያቂ ናቸው ብለው በሚያምኑት ወገን የሚካሄድ ማናቸውንም ምርመራ በጥርጣሬ ይመለከቱታል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti humnoota Israa’eliin kan ajjeefamte mucayyoo waggaa shan Hind Rajab, akaakayyoonshee qorannoo Israa’el du’ashee irratti jalqabe hin amannu jedhan. Akaakayyoonshee sirni seeraa Israa’el haqa ni argamsiisa jedhanii akka hin amanne ibsaniiru. Maatiin sun du’a mucayyoo isaanii kanaaf kan itti gaafatamu mootummaa Israa’el waan ta’eef, qorannoo isaan gaggeessan kamiyyuu akka hin amanne beeksisaniiru.

title: Pentagon quizzes NATO allies on political loyalty, documents reveal
english: The Pentagon has issued a questionnaire to NATO allies to evaluate their support for President Trump’s foreign policy and military objectives. The document specifically asks whether member nations are aligning with US positions regarding the Middle East and if they are willing to lift restrictions on American military access to their bases. Critics and foreign officials worry that this move unfairly pressures NATO members to participate in unilateral US operations outside the alliance's traditional scope.
amharic: የፔንታጎን አስተዳደር የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት ለፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመገምገም መጠይቅ ልኳል። ይህ ሰነድ አባል ሀገራት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ጉዳዮች ላይ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላቸውን አቋም እና ለጦር ሰፈሮቿ የሚሰጡትን ፈቃድ በተመለከተ ጥያቄዎችን ያነሳል። የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት በህብረቱ ስምምነት ውጪ በሆኑ የአሜሪካ የጦር እንቅስቃሴዎች ውስጥ እንዲሳተፉ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Pentagoniin biyyoota miseensa NATO ta'aniif, imaammata alaa kan Prezidaant Traamp deggeruu isaanii fi dhiisuu isaanii qorachuuf gaaffilee qopheesseera. Sanadichi biyyoonni kunneen dhimma Baha Giddu-galeessaa irratti sadarkaa fedhii Ameerikaa waliin akka hiriiran fi buufataalee waraanaa isaanii irratti ittisa jiru akka kaasan gaafata. Akkaataa kanaan, Ameerikaan biyyoota NATO walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kanneen maqaa NATOtiin ala ta'an keessatti akka hirmaatan dhiibbaa gochaa jirti jechuun namoonni dhimmi kun isaan yaaddesse komataniiru.

title: Lebanon hands former Syrian army general to Damascus after arrest warrant
english: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian Major-General Adel Issa to Damascus to face serious criminal charges, including torture and murder. This marks the first time Lebanon has transferred a former Syrian military official to the new government since the collapse of the Assad regime in 2024. Issa was arrested in Lebanon after visiting the Syrian embassy, following a widespread effort by Syrian authorities to hold former regime members accountable.
amharic: ሊባኖስ የቀድሞውን የሶሪያ ጦር ጄኔራል አዴል ኢሳን በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት እና በግድያ ወንጀል እንዲጠየቁ ለደማስቆ አስረክባለች። ይህ እርምጃ የባሻር አል-አሳድ አስተዳደር በ2024 ከወደቀ በኋላ ሊባኖስ በቀድሞ የሶሪያ ባለስልጣን ላይ የወሰደችው የመጀመሪያው የውክልና እርምጃ ነው። ጄኔራሉ በሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የሶሪያ ኤምባሲ በነበሩበት ወቅት በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው ነበር፣ ይህም በሶሪያ አዲስ መንግስት እየተካሄደ ካለው የቀድሞ ባለስልጣናትን የማደን ዘመቻ አንዱ ነው።
oromo: Libanoon ajaja waraanaa Siiriyaa duraanii jeneraal Adel Issaa, himata ajjeechaa fi dararamaa dabalatee yakka cimaan himatamuuf gara Daamaasqootti dabarsitee kenniteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan Bashar al-Assad bara 2024 erga kufee booda, Libanoon qondaala waraana Siiriyaa duraanii gara biyyaatti erguun ishee yeroo jalqabaati. Jeneraalichi kan qabaman embasii Siiriyaa kan Libanoo keessa jiru yeroo daawwatan ta'ee, kunis mootummaan Siiriyaa haaraan qondaaltota mootummaa duraanii irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu jalqabuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump announces ‘most crushing economic operation ever’ against Iran
english: US President Donald Trump has declared a massive new economic offensive against Iran, citing the failure of recent negotiations to end their ongoing conflict. He warned that any nation continuing to trade with Iran will face severe financial repercussions from the United States. Through these unprecedented sanctions, Trump aims to isolate the Iranian government and severely damage its economy.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት መፍትሄ ሳያገኝ በመቆየቱ ነው። ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራትም ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው ፕሬዚዳንቱ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, mariin nageenyaa kan biyyoota lamaanii milkaa'uu dhabuu hordofee, Itoophiyaa irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee cimaan fudhatamuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Biyyootni Itoophiyaa waliin daldala itti fufan hundi adabbii diinagdee cimaan akka irra ga'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun Itoophiyaa addunyaa irraa fageessuufi diinagdee ishee miidhuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Blast heard in Syria's Daraa
english: Syrian state media reported that a loud explosion occurred in the countryside of Daraa, a region in the southwestern part of the country. Details regarding the cause of the blast or any resulting casualties remain unknown. Authorities have not yet provided further information about the incident.
amharic: የሶሪያ የመንግስት ሚዲያዎች በደቡብ ምዕራብ ሶሪያ በምትገኘው የዳራ ግዛት ገጠር አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ እንደተሰማ ዘግበዋል። የፍንዳታው መንስኤ ምን እንደሆነ ወይም ስለደረሰው ጉዳት እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም። ባለስልጣናት ስለሁኔታው ተጨማሪ መግለጫ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Suuriyaa akka gabaasanitti, naannoo magaalaa Daaraa kan kibba-lixaa biyyattitti argamutti dhoohaan guddaan tokko dhaga'ameera. Sababa dhoohichaa fi miidhaa ga'e ilaalchisee odeeffannoon beekame hin jiru. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa haalicha irratti ibsa dabalataa hin kennine.

title: Jury refuses to convict seven Palestine Action defendants over Elbit raid
english: A London jury was unable to reach a verdict for seven Palestine Action activists accused of breaking into an Israeli-owned arms factory near Bristol. While one individual was found guilty of criminal damage, the court could not decide on the charges of violent disorder and property damage for the others. Consequently, prosecutors may now seek a retrial for the seven defendants involved in the 2024 protest incident.
amharic: የለንደን ፍርድ ቤት ዳኞች በብሪስቶል አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ የእስራኤል የጦር መሳሪያ ፋብሪካ ላይ ወረራ ፈጽመዋል በተባሉ ሰባት የፍልስጤም አክቲቪስቶች ላይ ውሳኔ መስጠት አልቻሉም። ከአንደኛው ተከሳሽ በስተቀር የቀሩት ተከሳሾች በንብረት ውድመት እና በሁከት ወንጀል የቀረበባቸው ክስ በአንድነት ሊረጋገጥ አልቻለም። በዚህም ምክንያት ለሰባቱ ተከሳሾች ዳግም ሙከራ ሊደረግላቸው እንደሚችል ተገልጿል።
oromo: Abbootiin seeraa London, warshaa meeshaa waraanaa kan Israa'el ta'e kan Bristolitti argamu cabsee seene jedhamanii kan himataman qabsaa'ota 'Palestine Action' torba irratti murtoo irra gahuu hin dandeenye. Namni tokko yakka qabeenya mancaasuu irratti yakkamus, himannaan warra kaanii garuu hin mirkanaa'in hafeera. Kanaafuu, himatamtoonni torba kun qabxiiwwan himannaa isaanirratti dhihaateen deebii irratti murtoo kennuuf qormaanni biraa akka isaan mudatuuf jira.

title: Australia summons Israeli ambassador over Gaza aid worker killing
english: The Australian government has summoned the Israeli ambassador to express strong dissatisfaction after Israel decided not to launch criminal investigations into the deaths of seven World Central Kitchen aid workers. Among the victims was Australian citizen Zomi Frankcom, who was killed in a 2024 airstrike in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong stated that the lack of accountability is unacceptable and expressed deep outrage at Israel's stance.
amharic: አውስትራሊያ ሰባት የዓለም ማዕከላዊ ኩሽና የረድኤት ሠራተኞችን በአየር ድብደባ ለገደለው እስራኤል ላይ የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደማይደረግ መወሰኗን ተከትሎ የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር ጠርታለች። በዚህ ጥቃት ከተገደሉት መካከል አውስትራሊያዊቷ ዞሚ ፍራንኮም ትገኝበታለች። የአውስትራሊያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ፔኒ ዎንግ ውሳኔው ተጠያቂነትን የማያረጋግጥ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ቅሬታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa Israa'el hojjattoota gargaarsa torba ajjeesuu ishee ilaalchisee qorannoo yakkaa banuu dhiisuu isheetiin wal qabatee, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamsiseera. Ajjeechaa bara 2024 Gaazaatti raawwatame kanaan namoota ajjeefaman keessaa lammiin Awustiraaliyaa Zomi Frankcom tokko turte. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Awustiraaliyaa Peni Wong, tarkiinichi itti gaafatamummaa kan hin mirkaneessine ta'uu ibsuun mufii guddaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Bahrain says Israeli attack on Syrian air base violates international law
english: Bahrain has officially denounced the recent Israeli airstrikes on a Syrian air base, labeling the action a breach of Syria's sovereignty. The Bahraini government argued that this military move violates international laws and the UN Charter while endangering regional stability. Through this statement, Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to upholding the independence and territorial integrity of Syria.
amharic: ባህሬን በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የፈጸመችውን ጥቃት የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት የጣሰ ተግባር ነው በማለት በይፋ አውግዛለች። የባህሬን መንግስት ይህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ዓለም አቀፍ ህጎችን እና የተባበሩት መንግስታት ቻርተርን እንደሚጥስ እና የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ገልጿል። በዚህ መግለጫ አማካኝነት ባህሬን የሶሪያን ነጻነት እና የግዛት አንድነት ለመጠበቅ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Bahrain miidhaa waraana Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaatti raawwate kana seeraan ala fi kabaja biyyaalessaa Suuriyaatti cabsuu dha jechuun balaaleffatteetti. Mootummaan Bahrain tarkaanfiin kun seera idil-addunyaa fi seera Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kan cabsu fi tasgabbii naannichaa kan booressu ta'uu ibseera. Ibsa kanaan, Bahrain kabaja biyyaalessaa fi walitti qalamuu daangaa Suuriyaaf gumaacha gochuuf qabdu mirkaneessiteetti.

title: US elections: Progressive Democrat scores shock win in Florida
english: In recent US primary elections, Florida state Representative Angie Nixon achieved a surprise victory over a well-funded opponent despite significantly lower campaign spending. Her platform focused on anti-war policies, healthcare access, and affordable housing. Meanwhile, other races in Alaska and Florida highlighted the continued influence of establishment politicians and groups like Aipac, despite challenges from candidates critical of US foreign policy in the Middle East.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተደረጉት የአሜሪካ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫዎች፣ የፍሎሪዳ ተወካይ አንጂ ኒክሰን ብዙ በጀት ካለው ተፎካካሪያቸው በተሻለ ሁኔታ ባልተጠበቀ ሁኔታ አሸንፈዋል። የኒክሰን ዘመቻ በጦርነት ተቃውሞ፣ በጤና አገልግሎት እና በተመጣጣኝ የቤት ዋጋ ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። በሌላ በኩል በአላስካ እና ፍሎሪዳ የተካሄዱት ምርጫዎች፣ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ ትችት በሚሰነዝሩ እጩዎች ቢፈታተኑም፣ ዋና ዋና የፖለቲካ ተቋማት እና የኤይፓክ (Aipac) ተፅዕኖ አሁንም ጠንካራ መሆኑን አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Filannoo duraa kan Yunaayitid Isteetis dhiheenya adeemsifameen, bakka buutuun mootummaa Florida Angie Nixon morkataa baajata guddaa qabu injifachuun nama dinqisiise. Duulli isheen geggeessites mormii waraanaa, tajaajila fayyaa fi gabaa mana jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffate. Gama biraatiin, filannoon Alaska fi Florida adeemsifame, namoonni siyaasa ala Yunaayitid Isteetis irratti komii qaban jiraatanis, dhaabbilee siyaasaa bebbeekamoo fi gareen Aipac jedhamu dhiibbaa guddaa qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseera.

title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
english: The Australian government has expressed deep frustration following Israel's decision not to file criminal charges against those involved in the 2024 killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom and her colleagues in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong described the lack of accountability as insulting, noting that the strikes were already admitted to be the result of procedural failures and errors. Australia intends to summon the Israeli ambassador to formally demand justice for the victims.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ መንግስት በጋዛ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ሰራተኛዋን ዞሚ ፍራንኮምን እና የስራ ባልደረቦቿን በገደሉት ላይ እስራኤል ክስ ላለመመስረት የወሰደችውን ውሳኔ ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ቁጣውን ገልጿል። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሯ ፔኒ ዎንግ ውሳኔው ተጠያቂነትን የሚያረጋግጥ ባለመሆኑ አሳፋሪ ነው ብለዋል። አውስትራሊያ ለሟቾች ፍትህ እንዲሰፍን የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቷን እንደምትቀጥል እና የእስራኤልን አምባሳደር ጠርታ ማብራሪያ እንደምትጠይቅ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Awustiraaliyaa akkaataa ajjeechaa hojjetaa gargaarsa namoomaa Zoomii Firaankoom fi hiriyoota ishee Gaazaatti raawwatame ilaalchisee Israa'el namoota himataman irratti himata banuu dhiisuu ishee mormiteetti. Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Peni Wong akka ibsetti, tarkiinni Israa'el kun itti gaafatamummaa kan hin mirkaneessine fi kan nama gaddisiisu dha. Awustiraaliyaan miidhamtootaaf haqni akka argamuuf ejjennoo ishee cimsitee itti fufuun, ambaasaaddara Israa'el waamtee mari'achuuf karoorfattetti.

title: What the social media addiction lawsuit could cost Meta
english: Meta is currently facing a major federal trial involving 29 states that accuse the company of designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive for young users. If the court rules against the tech giant, the company could be forced to restructure its platforms and pay massive fines reaching up to $200 billion. This case poses a significant financial threat to Meta as it already struggles with declining internal morale and previous legal penalties.
amharic: ሜታ ፌስቡክ እና ኢንስታግራም ለወጣት ተጠቃሚዎች ሱስ የሚያስይዙ እንዲሆኑ ተደርገው የተሰሩ ናቸው በሚል በ29 ግዛቶች የተመሰረተበትን ትልቅ የፍርድ ቤት ክስ እየገጠመው ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ በኩባንያው ላይ ውሳኔ ካሳለፈ፣ ሜታ የመድረኮቹን አወቃቀር እንዲቀይር እና እስከ 200 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት እንዲከፍል ሊገደድ ይችላል። ይህ ክስ ቀደም ሲል በኩባንያው ላይ የደረሱ የህግ ቅጣቶች እና የውስጥ ችግሮች እንዳሉበት ሁኔታ፣ ሜታ ላይ ትልቅ የገንዘብ ጫና ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Meta dhaabbilee mootummaa 29 ta'aniin Facebook fi Instagram ijoollee fi dargaggoota qabachuuf jedhanii akka fedhii isaanitti akka qophaa'an himatamee mana murtiitti dhiyaateera. Himata kana kan mo'atame yoo ta'e, Meta sirna platformii isaa jijjiiruu fi hanga biliyoona 200 doolaaraa kaffaluuf dirqamuu danda'a. Himanni kun Meta irratti dhiibbaa dinagdee cimaa uumuu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoolee keessoo fi himata kanaan dura irratti dhiyaatan irratti kan dabalatuudha.

title: “I get along with him very well.”
english: US President Donald Trump has expressed positive sentiments regarding his relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. The two leaders are expected to hold a meeting later this year to discuss ongoing matters. This development follows President Trump's decision to reduce the scope of joint military exercises involving US and South Korean forces.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ያላቸው ግንኙነት መልካም መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሁለቱ መሪዎች በዓመቱ መጨረሻ ላይ ለመገናኘት እቅድ እንዳላቸው ተነግሯል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው ፕሬዚዳንቱ ከአሜሪካ እና ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ወታደሮች ጋር ሲካሄድ የነበረውን የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምድ እንዲቀንስ ትዕዛዝ ከሰጡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Prezidaantichi Amerikaa Donald Traamp hariiroo isaan hoogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kiim Joong Un waliin qaban gaarii akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Hoogganoonni kunneen dhimmoota garaagaraa mari'achuuf waggaa kana keessa wal arguuf karoorfataniiru. Taateen kun kan dhufe erga prezidaant Traamp humni waraanaa Ameerikaa fi Kooriyaa Kibbaa leenjii waraanaa waliinii irratti godhaa turan akka hir'atu ajajanii booda dha.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza City police headquarters kills women’s police chief
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a police headquarters in Gaza City resulted in the deaths of the head of the women’s police force, multiple officers, and a teenager. This lethal operation occurred shortly after a diplomatic visit by a US envoy concluded without achieving a ceasefire agreement. The incident highlights the ongoing violence in the region despite recent international efforts to de-escalate the conflict.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ጥቃት የሴቶች ፖሊስ አዛዥ፣ በርካታ መኮንኖች እና አንድ የ13 ዓመት ታዳጊ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ጃሬድ ኩሽነር የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ ሳይደርሱ ጉብኝታቸውን ካጠናቀቁ ከሁለት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት እና የሰላም ጥረቶች እየተገዳደሩ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el waajjira poolisii magaala Gaza irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateen ajajaan poolisii dubartootaa, poolisoonni biroo fi ijoolleen umriin isaanii waggaa 13 tokko du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame ergamtootni Ameerikaa walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa irratti osoo hin marihatin daawwannaa isaanii erga xumuranii guyyaa lama booda. Gochi kun haala waraanaa naannichatti jiru kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, carraaqqiin nagaa buusuuf godhamaa jiru milkaa'ina dhabuu isaa kan mul'isuudha.

title: Displaced Lebanese watch southern Lebanon’s ‘pilot zones’ from afar
english: Many Lebanese citizens who fled their homes in the southern part of the country are now forced to watch from a distance as Israeli forces conduct military operations in the region. These displaced families are witnessing the destruction of their towns and villages, which are being identified as 'pilot zones.' Residents report feeling helpless as they observe the ongoing devastation of their communities from afar.
amharic: ከደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተፈናቀሉ በርካታ ሊባኖሳውያን በእስራኤል ኃይሎች እየደረሰ ያለውን የጥፋት ዘመቻ ከሩቅ በመመልከት ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ሰዎች የትውልድ መንደሮቻቸው እና ከተሞቻቸው 'የሙከራ ቀጠናዎች' ተብለው እየፈራረሱ መሆናቸውን በከፍተኛ ስቃይ እየተመለከቱ ነው። የተፈናቃይ ቤተሰቦች ቤታቸው ሲወድም ምንም ማድረግ ባለመቻላቸው የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ሀዘን እና አቅመቢስነት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Namoonni biyyattii gama kibbaa irraa buqqa'an hedduun, qabeenyi isaanii fi manneen isaanii weerara waraana Israa'elitiin yommuu barbadaa'u fagoo irraa ilaaluuf dirqamaniiru. Magaalotaa fi ganda isaanii keessatti bakkeen kun 'naannoo qorannoo' jedhamanii waamamuun iddoo waraanni itti gaggeeffamu ta'aniiru. Namoonni buqqa'an kun iddoo jireenya isaanii irratti miidhaan ga'u arguun isaanii yaaddoo fi gadda guddaa keessa isaan galcheera.

title: Israel orders inquiry into killing of 6-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza
english: The Israeli military has officially launched criminal investigations into the deaths of six-year-old Hind Rajab and 15 humanitarian workers in Gaza after more than two years. Despite this development, families of the victims and various human rights organizations remain doubtful about the process. They argue that past military inquiries of this nature have seldom resulted in legal accountability or convictions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከሁለት ዓመት በላይ ካለፈ በኋላ የስድስት ዓመቷን ሂንድ ራጃብ እና 15 የሰብአዊ መብት ሰራተኞችን ግድያ በተመለከተ የወንጀል ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እርምጃ ቢወሰድም፣ የተጎጂዎች ቤተሰቦች እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በምርመራው ውጤታማነት ላይ ያላቸውን ጥርጣሬ ገልጸዋል። ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ተመሳሳይ ወታደራዊ ምርመራዎች በህግ ተጠያቂነት ወይም በቅጣት እምብዛም እንደማይጠናቀቁ በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ያንፀባርቃሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el waggaa lama ol booda, du'a intala umriin ishee ja'a ta'e Hind Raajaab fi gargaartota namoomaa 15 Gaza keessatti ajjeefamanii irratti qorannoo yakkaa jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Haata'u malee, maatiin shiraa'anii fi dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa qorannoo kana irratti shakki qabu. Qorannoowwan kanaan dura waraanaan godhaman yeroo baay'ee seeraan gaafatamaa fi murtiidhaan waan hin xumurameef, jijjiirama dhugaa ni fida jedhanii hin amanan.

title: USS Lincoln woes highlight US Navy limits in prolonged Iran war: Experts
english: The extended deployment of the USS Abraham Lincoln amid the ongoing conflict with Iran has sparked concerns regarding the US Navy's operational capacity and logistical planning. Reports of low crew morale, supply shortages, and maintenance problems suggest that the military is struggling to sustain long-term operations in the region. Experts warn that these readiness challenges could weaken American deterrence and highlight the practical limits of naval power during a drawn-out war.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት የዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ረጅም ጊዜ መቆየት የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይልን የአቅም ውስንነት እና የሎጂስቲክስ እቅድ ጥያቄ ውስጥ ከቶታል። በሰራተኞቹ ላይ የሚታየው የሞራል መውደቅ፣ የአቅርቦት እጥረት እና የጥገና ችግሮች ጦርነቱ እየጎተተ ሲሄድ ወታደራዊ ዝግጁነት እየተዳከመ መሆኑን ያሳያል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት እነዚህ ተግዳሮቶች የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ ተፅእኖ ሊያዳክሙ እንደሚችሉ ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Humni galaana Ameerikaa doonii USS Abraham Lincoln jedhamu waraana Iran wajjin jiruun walqabatee yeroodhaaf naannichatti tursiisuun isaa rakkoo humnaa fi karooraa irratti yaaddoo uumeera. Hojjettoota doonichaa irratti hir’ina amantii, rakkoo dhiyeessii fi rakkoolee suphaa mul’atan irratti hundaa’uun, waraanni kun yoo dheerate humna waraanaa irratti dhiibbaa akka fidu ibsameera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, rakkooleen kun qophiin waraanaa Ameerikaa akka laafu gochuu danda’u jedhanii akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Spain plans transfer of 500 migrant children from Ceuta to mainland
english: The Spanish government is moving 500 unaccompanied minors from Ceuta to the mainland to relieve severe overcrowding in the enclave's shelter system. This decision follows a massive influx of migrants that left local facilities operating well beyond their intended capacity. While local leaders in Ceuta advocate for returning the children to Morocco, national officials have rejected mass deportations, prioritizing the children's welfare and placement in foster care across Spain.
amharic: የስፔን መንግስት በሴኡታ ከተማ ባሉ መጠለያዎች ላይ የደረሰውን ከፍተኛ የህዝብ መጨናነቅ ለማቃለል 500 ታዳጊ ህጻናትን ወደ ዋናው የስፔን ግዛት ለማዛወር አቅዷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው በቅርቡ በድንበር በኩል በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የስደተኞች ፍሰት ምክንያት የአካባቢው መጠለያዎች አቅም ከመጠን በላይ በመጨመሩ ነው። የሴኡታ አስተዳዳሪዎች ህጻናቱ ወደ ሞሮኮ እንዲመለሱ ቢጠይቁም፣ የስፔን መንግስት የህጻናትን ደህንነት በመቅደም እና በተለያዩ የስፔን ክፍሎች በማስፈር የጅምላ መመለስን ተቃውሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ispeen daa'imman gargaarsa malee achi jiran 500 magaalaa Se'uutaa irraa gara biyya keessaatti jijjiiruuf karoorfateera; kunis bakka buufataalee daa'immanii irratti uumame hir'isuuf gargaara. Murtuun kun kan dhufte godaantota hedduun daangaa ce'uun isaanii fi bakka buufataaleen gahaa akka hin taane erga hubatame booda. Bulchitoonni Se'uutaa daa'imman kun gara Morookootti akka deebi'an barbaadanis, mootummaan biyyattii garuu deebisuu mormuun nageenya daa'immanii fi bakka buusuu isaanii irratti xiyyeeffachaa jira.

title: Moderna, Merck unveil mRNA-based cancer vaccine that cuts spread
english: Moderna and Merck have developed a new mRNA-based vaccine called Intismeran, which has successfully reduced the recurrence and spread of melanoma in clinical trials. By combining the vaccine with immunotherapy, the treatment teaches the body's immune system to specifically target and fight cancerous mutations. This breakthrough marks the first time an mRNA cancer vaccine has reached such positive results in late-stage testing, offering hope for patients with high-risk tumors.
amharic: ሞደርና እና መርክ የተባሉት ኩባንያዎች ኢንቲስሜራን የተሰኘ አዲስ የካንሰር መከላከያ ክትባት ማዘጋጀታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ኤምአርኤንኤ (mRNA) ላይ የተመሰረተ ክትባት ከሌሎች የህክምና ዘዴዎች ጋር በመቀናጀት የሰውነት በሽታ ተከላካይ ስርዓት የካንሰር ሴሎችን ለይቶ እንዲያጠቃ ያደርገዋል። በክሊኒካዊ ሙከራዎች እንደተረጋገጠው፣ ክትባቱ የሜላኖማ ካንሰር እንደገና እንዳያገረሽ እና እንዳይዛመት በመከላከል ረገድ ትልቅ ስኬት አስመዝግቧል።
oromo: Moderna fi Merck talaallii kaansarii haaraa mRNA irratti hundaa'e kan Intismeran jedhamu qopheessaniiru. Talaalliin kun sirna ittisa qaamaa kakaasuun qaamni keenya akka kaansarii ofirraa ittisuu fi duula baasu gargaara. Qorannoo gaggeeffameen, talaalliin kun kaansarii gogaa (melanoma) irra deebi'ee akka hin mudanne fi qaama biraatti akka hin babal'anne gochuun bu'aa guddaa argamsiiseera.

title: UK ‘deeply concerned’ about Israeli strikes on Syrian air base
english: The British representative for Syria, Barrie Peach, has expressed serious alarm regarding recent Israeli military strikes on an air base in Syria. He warned that such actions threaten the stability of the region and urged Israel to uphold Syrian national sovereignty. Furthermore, the UK is calling for a return to diplomatic talks to foster lasting peace between the nations.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ የሶሪያ ልዩ ተወካይ ባሪ ፒች በእስራኤል በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ ስለተፈጸመው ጥቃት ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። እንደዚህ ያሉ ድርጊቶች የሶሪያን ሰላም እና መረጋጋት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉ በማሳሰብ፣ እስራኤል የሶሪያን ሉዓላዊነት እንድታከብር ጠይቀዋል። ለክልሉ ዘላቂ ሰላም ሲባል ሁለቱ ወገኖች ወደ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግር እንዲመለሱ እንግሊዝ አሳስባለች።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan UK kan biyya Suriyaa Barrie Peach, haleellaa Israa'el buufata xiyyaaraa Suriyaa irratti raawwatteef yaaddoo cimaa qaban ibsaniiru. Gochi kun tasgabbii naannichaa miidhuu danda'a waan ta'eef, Israa'el kabajaa biyyoolessummaa Suriyaa akka eegdu gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, UK nageenya waaraa fiduuf jecha, Israa'el gara marii dippilomaasii akka deebitu gorsiteetti.

title: Oil supertankers in Gulf are renting for $500,000 per day: Report
english: The cost to rent massive oil tankers to transport crude from the Persian Gulf to Asia has skyrocketed to over $500,000 per day. This surge in shipping prices is driven by ongoing regional conflicts that have restricted vessel availability and forced oil shipments onto longer, alternative routes. Despite the significant security risks and active military hostilities, shipowners are accepting the high premiums to continue moving energy supplies to global markets.
amharic: ከፋርስ ባሕረ ሰላጤ ወደ እስያ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ለማጓጓዝ የሚውሉ ግዙፍ የነዳጅ መርከቦችን ለመከራየት የሚወጣው ወጪ በቀን ከ500,000 ዶላር በላይ ደርሷል። ይህ የመርከብ ኪራይ ዋጋ ጭማሪ በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት የመርከቦችን አቅርቦት በመቀነሱ እና ነዳጅ ወደ ሌሎች ረጅም መንገዶች እንዲዛወር በማድረጉ የመጣ ነው። በክልሉ ከፍተኛ የፀጥታ ስጋት እና ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ቢኖሩም፣ የመርከብ ባለቤቶች ከፍተኛ ትርፍ ለማግኘት ሲሉ ነዳጅ ወደ ዓለም ገበያ ለማድረስ ዝግጁ ሆነዋል።
oromo: Gatii dooniiwwan gurguddoo boba'aa (supertankers) galdii Persian Gulf irraa gara biyyoota Eshiyaatti boba'aa geessan kireeffachuu guyyaatti doolaara 500,000 ol ga'eera. Daballiin gatii kun kan dhufe waldhabdee naannichatti jiruun walqabatee dooniiwwan argachuun ulfaachuu fi boba'aan gara karaa dheeraa biraatti akka geeddaramu waan dirqisiiseef dha. Balaa nageenyaa fi waraanni jiraatu illee, abbootiin dooniiwwanii gatii ol'aanaa kaffalameen boba'aa gabaa addunyaatti geessuu itti fufaniiru.

title: In photos: Aftermath of Israeli strikes on Gaza
english: Following recent Israeli airstrikes in Gaza City, local residents were captured on camera relocating victims from the affected area. These images highlight the ongoing humanitarian impact of the conflict on displaced civilians. The situation continues to result in significant loss of life and displacement within the region.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ድብደባ ምክንያት በአካባቢው የነበሩ ነዋሪዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ከቦታው ሲያጓጉዙ የሚያሳዩ ምስሎች ወጥተዋል። እነዚህ ፎቶግራፎች ግጭቱ በተፈናቀሉ ሲቪሎች ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያሳያሉ። በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በክልሉ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና መፈናቀል አሳሳቢ ደረጃ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaa irratti haleellaa erga raawwatee booda, jiraattonni miidhaan irra ga'eefi du'an bakka haleellaarraa kaasuun argamu. Suuraaleen kun bu'aa hammeenyaa waraanni kun namoota buqqatan irratti qabu ifatti mul'isu. Haalli kun kutaalee kana keessatti lubbuu baay'ee akka darbuufi namoonni hedduun akka buqqatan godheera.

title: UAE-funded mercenary targeted British activist in London, report says
english: A new investigation reveals that a mercenary paid by the United Arab Emirates conducted covert surveillance on Anas al-Tikriti, a British activist and academic, in London in 2016. Abraham Golan, who ran a private security firm, reportedly monitored the activist's daily routines and even discussed the possibility of physical elimination. The operation reportedly targeted Tikriti because the UAE government associated his think tank with groups they designate as terrorists.
amharic: አዲስ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች የተከፈለ ቅጥረኛ በ2016 በለንደን በሚገኘው የብሪታንያ አክቲቪስት እና ምሁር አናስ አል-ቲክሪቲ ላይ የስለላ ስራ ሲያካሂድ ነበር። የግል የደህንነት ድርጅት ባለቤት የነበረው አብርሃም ጎላን የአክቲቪስቱን የእለት ተእለት እንቅስቃሴ ሲከታተል እንደነበርና እንዲያውም በአካል የመጉዳት እቅድ እንዳለው ሲወያይ እንደነበር ተነግሯል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች መንግስት አል-ቲክሪቲን እና ድርጅታቸውን ከአሸባሪ ቡድኖች ጋር በማያያዙ ይህ የስለላ ስራ እንዲከናወን አድርገዋል።
oromo: qorannoon haaraan tokko akka ibsuutti, biyyi UAE qaxaramee hojjetu tokko bara 2016 Londonitti nama biyya UK, Anas al-Tikriti jedhamu irratti basaasummaa akka gaggeesse beekameera. Abbaan qabeenyaa dhaabbata nageenyaa kan ta'e Abrahaam Goolaan, sochii guyyaa guyyaa namicha kanaa hordofaa akka ture fi miidhaa qaamaa irraan gahuuf illee akka mari'ate himameera. Mootummaan UAE, Anas al-Tikriti fi dhaabbata isaa garee shororkeessaa waliin wal-qabsiisuun isaa xiyyeeffannoo kanatti akka geesse himama.

title: What’s behind Israel’s latest attack on Syria?
english: Israel recently launched an airstrike on a Syrian airbase, sparking widespread international criticism. A US envoy warned that the operation was dangerous because it risked causing a direct military clash with Turkish forces present in the region. Experts are currently analyzing the underlying reasons for the strike and the potential long-term geopolitical consequences for the Middle East.
amharic: እስራኤል በቅርቡ በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሟ ሰፊ ዓለም አቀፍ ትችቶችን አስከትሏል። አንድ የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት ጥቃቱ በክልሉ ከሚገኙ የቱርክ ኃይሎች ጋር ቀጥተኛ ግጭት የመቀስቀስ አደጋ እንደነበረው አስጠንቅቀዋል። ባለሙያዎች የዚህ ጥቃት ዋና ምክንያቶች እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ላይ ሊያስከትል የሚችለውን የፖለቲካ ውጤት እየመረመሩ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el dhiyeenya kana buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa irratti haleellaa raawwatteen mormii guddaa addunyaa irraa isheetti fidee jira. Ergamtuun tokko kan Amerikaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun humnoota Turkii naannichatti argaman waliin walitti buiinsa kallattiin fiduu danda'a ture. Hayyoonni sababii haleellaa kanaa fi dhiibbaa inni gara fuulduraatti naannoo sana irratti qabaachuu danda'u irratti qorannoo taasisaa jiru.

title: Seven people, mostly foreign tourists, killed in helicopter crash in Kenya
english: A tourist helicopter crashed in a remote region of northern Kenya, resulting in the deaths of all seven people on board. The victims included five Americans, a high-ranking Ecuadorian intelligence official, and an NBCUniversal journalist. Kenyan authorities have launched an investigation into the cause of the accident, which occurred while the aircraft was traveling between two popular safari locations.
amharic: በሰሜን ኬንያ በተከሰተ የሄሊኮፕተር አደጋ በውስጡ የነበሩ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል። ከተጎጂዎቹ መካከል አምስት አሜሪካውያን፣ የኢኳዶር የስለላ ክፍል ኃላፊ እና አንድ የኤንቢሲ ዩኒቨርሳል ጋዜጠኛ ይገኙበታል። አውሮፕላኑ ከቱሪስት መዳረሻዎች መካከል በሚጓዝበት ወቅት የደረሰውን ይህንን አደጋ ተከትሎ የኬንያ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Keeniyaa kaabaatti xiyyaarri helikoptaraa tokko kufuunsaa hordofee namoonni torba lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Miidhamtoota kana keessa lammiileen Ameerikaa shan, hoggantoonni ogeessota odeeffannoo Ekuwaador fi gaazexeessaan dhaabbata NBCUniversal tokko ni argamu. Helikoptarichi iddoo bashannana tuuristii lama gidduutti utuu deemaa jiruu kan kute yoo ta'u, mootummaan Keeniyaa sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo jalqabeera.

title: Remains of 11 Palestinians recovered from rubble in Gaza City
english: Civil defense workers in Gaza City have recovered the bodies of 11 Palestinians from a destroyed home in the Zeitoun neighborhood. Rescue operations are continuing at new locations, though efforts remain hindered by a severe shortage of heavy equipment. It is estimated that approximately 10,000 individuals are still missing and likely trapped under the debris throughout the territory.
amharic: የጋዛ ከተማ ሲቪል መከላከያ ሰራተኞች በዘይቱን ሰፈር በፈረሰ ቤት ውስጥ የነበሩ የ11 ፍልስጤማውያን አስከሬን አግኝተዋል። የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በሌሎች ቦታዎች የቀጠሉ ቢሆንም፣ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ከባድ ማሽኖች ባለመኖራቸው ስራው ተግዳሮት ሆኖበታል። በአሁኑ ወቅት በጠቅላላው የጋዛ ግዛት ፍርስራሽ ስር ከ10,000 በላይ ሰዎች የገቡ እና የጠፉ እንደሆኑ ይገመታል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni ittisa sivilii magaalaa Gaazaatti, mana nannoo Zeytuunitti diigame keessaa reeffa namoota 11 argachuu isaanii gabaasaniiru. Hojiin barbaacha namoota biroo bakka gara garaatti itti fufee kan jiru ta’us, meeshaalee gurguddaa dhabuun carraaqqii kana harka qulleessa taasiseera. Gaazaa keessatti namoonni 10,000 ol ta’an manneen diigamaniin haguugamanii akka jiran shakkarama.

title: Israel admits that it fired on vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab
english: The Israeli military has officially acknowledged firing on a vehicle in Gaza that was carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab and her relatives. This incident, which occurred in early 2024, resulted in the deaths of nine people, including the young girl who had previously called for help while trapped in the car. Authorities have now announced that a formal criminal investigation will be conducted into the circumstances surrounding the attack.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአምስት ዓመቷ ህጻን ሂንድ ራጃብ እና ቤተሰቦቿ ላይ ጥቃት መክፈቱን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በይፋ አምኗል። እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 መጀመሪያ ላይ በተፈጠረው በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ህጻኗን ጨምሮ ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት በድርጊቱ ዙሪያ የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደሚከፍት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el konkolaataa ijoollee waggaa shan Hind Rajab fi maatiin ishee keessa turan irratti dhukaasa banuu isaa yeroo jalqabaaf beekamtii kenneera. Fulbaana bara 2024 keessa mudate kanaan, ijoollee dabalatee namoonni sagal lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Amma mootummaan Israa'el ajjeechaa kana irratti qorannoo yakkaa gaggeessuuf karoorfachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Israeli military fire wounds two Palestinians in West Bank's Qusra
english: Israeli forces injured two Palestinians, a 70-year-old and a 15-year-old, during a house raid in the West Bank village of Qusra. This incident follows a week of persistent attacks and blockades carried out by Israeli settlers against the local community. The Palestinian Red Crescent confirmed that the two individuals were wounded by gunfire during the military operation.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በምዕራብ ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር ባደረጉት ቤት ለቤት ፍተሻ አንድ የ70 ዓመት አዛውንት እና አንድ የ15 ዓመት ወጣት ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በአካባቢው የሚገኙ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ላለፉት አንድ ሳምንት በመንደሩ ላይ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶችን እና ከበባ ሲያደርጉ መቆየቱን ተከትሎ ነው። የፍልስጤም ቀይ ጨረቃ ድርጅት ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች በወታደሮቹ ጥይት እንደቆሰሉ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el ganda Qusraa kan Qarqara Dhihaatti argamtu keessatti mana tokko irratti duula gaggeessaniin, dargaggeessa waggaa 15 fi jaarsa waggaa 70 ta'an irratti miidhaa geessisaniiru. Miidhaan kun kan hordofe, torbee darbe guutuu qubattoonni Israa'el ganda kana irratti weerara fi marsaa gaggeessaa turan. Waldaan Hilba Diimaa Falasxiin akka mirkaneessetti, namoonni lamaan kun dhukaasa humnoota waraanaan miidhamaniiru.

title: Trump says US to reopen negotiations with Iran ‘maybe at some point’
english: President Donald Trump indicated that the United States could potentially restart diplomatic discussions with Iran in the future. He emphasized that the primary condition for any new agreement is for Iran to completely abandon its nuclear weapons program. Trump stated that the U.S. is firmly committed to preventing Iran from acquiring such arms because of the potential security risks.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ወደፊት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለሚደረጉ ድርድሮች ኢራን ክፍት ልትሆን እንደምትችል ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል። ለዚህም ዋነኛው ቅድመ ሁኔታ ኢራን የኒውክሌር የጦር መሳሪያ ፕሮግራሟን ሙሉ በሙሉ ማቆም እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ለደህንነት ስትል ኢራን የኒውክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳትይዝ በጥብቅ እንደምትቃወምም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donald Tiraamp gara fuulduraatti mariin Itoophiyaa fi Iraan gidduutti deebi'ee jalqabamuu akka danda'u ibsaniiru. Haata'u malee, mariiwwan haarawaaf haalli guddaan barbaadamu Iraan meeshaa niwukilaaraa qabaachuu dhiisuu akka ta'e himaniiru. Ameerikaan nageenya ishee eeggachuuf jecha, Iraan meeshaa akkasii akka hin arganne cimsitee akka falmatu dubbataniiru.

title: 582 skeletons, including children discovered in Sri Lanka mass grave
english: Excavators in Sri Lanka have unearthed a mass grave containing 582 skeletons, which include the remains of infants and children. This site is believed to be connected to the killings of Tamil civilians by the military during the country's civil war. Despite the gravity of the discovery, investigations into these tragic deaths have been stalled for three decades.
amharic: በስሪ ላንካ በተደረገ ቁፋሮ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ የ582 ሰዎች አፅም የተገኘበት የጅምላ መቃብር ተገኝቷል። ቦታው ከእርስ በርስ ጦርነቱ ወቅት በታሚል ሲቪሎች ላይ ተፈጽሟል በተባለ ወታደራዊ ግድያ ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ይታመናል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ግኝት ቢኖርም፣ ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ የሚደረገው ምርመራ ለሰላሳ ዓመታት ዘግይቶ ቆይቷል።
oromo: Siri Laankaa keessatti awwaala gamtaa bakka reeffi namoota 582, kanneen keessatti ijoollee fi daa'imman argaman keessatti qotamee argameera. Bakki kun yeroo waraana biyyoolessaa sana keessa waraanni siviloota Tamilii irratti ajjeechaa raawwate jedhamee shakkama. Dhugaan kun odoo beekamuu, qorannoon ajjeechaa suukanneessaa kanaa waggoota soddomaaf osoo hin gaggeeffamin tureera.

title: Protests in Kyiv back ex-defence minister Fedorov’s call for elections
english: Demonstrators gathered in Kyiv to demand the resumption of wartime elections, following a call made by the former defense minister, Mykailo Fedorov. These protests took place simultaneously with the parliament's confirmation of Yevhenii Khmara as the new defense minister. The event highlights growing public pressure regarding the country's democratic processes amid the ongoing conflict.
amharic: በኪዬቭ የሚገኙ ተቃዋሚዎች የቀድሞ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ሚካኢሎ ፌዶሮቭ ያቀረቡትን የጦር ጊዜ ምርጫ የማካሄድ ጥሪ በመደገፍ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። ሰልፉ የተካሄደው የዩክሬን ፓርላማ የፌዶሮቭን ተተኪ የሆኑትን የቭሄኒ ክማራን ሹመት ባፀደቀበት ዕለት ነው። ይህ ክስተት በጦርነቱ መሃል ሀገሪቱ በዴሞክራሲያዊ አሰራር ላይ ያላትን የህዝብ ግፊት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hiriirtonni magaalaa Kiyyivitti walgahanii, ministirri ittisa biyyattii duraanii Mykailo Fedorov filannoo yeroo waraanaatti akka gaggeeffamu waamicha dhiyeessan deggeran. Hiriirri kun kan gaggeeffame guyyaa paarlaamaan Yukreen Yevhenii Khmara ministira ittisaa haaraa godhee muude waliin wal-qabatee dha. Taateen kun waraana keessatti adeemsa dimokiraasii biyyattii irratti dhiibbaan ummataa dabalaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Violence in the New Syria?
english: Protests have erupted in Syria following the death of Mohammad Ghamira, a rescue worker with the White Helmets who reportedly died after being beaten in police custody. His passing has triggered widespread public concern regarding the potential resurgence of human rights violations similar to those seen under the previous regime. In response to the growing unrest, the Syrian Interior Ministry has launched an official investigation into the incident.
amharic: የነጭ ኮፍያ አዳኝ የሆነው መሐመድ ጋሚራ በፖሊስ እስር ቤት ውስጥ በደረሰበት ድብደባ ህይወቱ ማለፉን ተከትሎ በሶሪያ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በአገሪቱ ውስጥ በአሳድ ዘመን ይታዩ የነበሩ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች እንደገና እንዳይከሰቱ ህዝቡ ስጋት እንዲገባ አድርጓል። የሶሪያ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ጉዳዩን ለመመርመር ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Garee gargaartota 'White Helmets' keessaa kan ta'e Mohammad Ghamira, harka poolisii jiru keessatti reebicha irra ga'een lubbuun isaa darbuun isaa sabaa himuun mormii kaaseera. Duuti kun hawaasa biratti mirga namoomaa fi dhiibbaa mootummaa darbee sanaa irra deebi'amee mul'achuu danda'a jedhanii akka sodaatan taasiseera. Ministeerri dhimma keessaa Sooriyaa wanti kun akkamitti akka raawwatame qorannoo eegaluu isaa ibseera.

title: Trump nominates Heidi Overton to lead US Food and Drug Administration
english: President Donald Trump has nominated Dr. Heidi Overton to serve as the new commissioner of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). Previously a policy advisor at a think tank aligned with the administration, Overton is expected to implement “America First” health policies. Her appointment now requires confirmation from the United States Senate to fill the position left vacant since May.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዶክተር ሃይዲ ኦቨርተንን የአሜሪካ የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት አስተዳደር (FDA) አዲሱ ኮሚሽነር አድርገው ሾሙ። ቀደም ሲል ለፕሬዝዳንቱ ቅርብ በሆነ የምርምር ተቋም ውስጥ የፖሊሲ አማካሪ የነበሩት ኦቨርተን፣ በአስተዳደሩ የታቀደውን “አሜሪካ ቀዳሚ” የጤና ፖሊሲ ተግባራዊ እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል። ሹመታቸው በግንቦት ወር ከተለቀቀው ክፍት የሥራ ቦታ ለመተካት በአሜሪካ ሴኔት መጽደቅ ይኖርበታል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Donaald Tiraamp, Dr. Hayidii Oovarteenin komishinara haaraa kan 'Food and Drug Administration' (FDA) godhanii filataniiru. Kanaan dura dhaabbata yaadaa kan mootummaa waliin hidhata qabu keessatti gorsituu siyaasaa ta'anii kan hojjechaa turan Oovarteen, imaammata fayyaa kan 'America First' jedhamu akka raawwachiisan eeggama. Muudamni isaanii kun bakka ji'a darbe irraa kaasee duwwaa ture guutuuf, mana maree seera baastuu (Senate) Ameerikaatiin mirkanaa'uu qaba.

title: Zambian opposition leader to challenge election result in ⁠court
english: Zambian opposition leader Brian Mundubile plans to take legal action to contest President Hakainde Hichilema's re-election, citing significant fraud and procedural errors. The opposition claims the electoral process was undermined by unfair campaign restrictions and intimidation tactics. While the President secured a second term with 60 percent of the vote, these allegations and the recent arrest of opposition figures have created political instability.
amharic: የዛምቢያ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ መሪ ብሪያን ሙንዱቢሌ በፕሬዝዳንት ሃካይንዴ ሂቺሌማ ድጋሚ ምርጫ ላይ ከባድ የድምፅ አሰጣጥ ማጭበርበር ተፈፅሟል በሚል ለፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ ለማቅረብ ወስነዋል። ተቃዋሚው ወገን የምርጫው ሂደት በዘመቻ ጊዜ ገደቦች እና ማስፈራሪያዎች የተሞላ እንደነበር ይናገራሉ። ምንም እንኳን ፕሬዝዳንቱ በ60 በመቶ ድምፅ አሸናፊ ቢሆኑም፣ የቀረበው ክስ እና በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የተፈጸመው እስር በሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hogganaan mormituu Zambiyaa Biriyaani Munduubiile, filannoo pirezidaant Haakayinde Hiichiilemaan injifatan irratti dogoggoraafi soba raawwatameera jechuun gara mana murtiitti fudhachuuf karoorfateera. Gareen mormituu akka jedhutti, adeemsi filannichaa dhiibbaa fi sodaa qaama mootummaan irratti godhamee ture jechuun himatu. Pirezidaantichi sagalee 60 dhibbeentaa argatanii kan mo’atan ta’us, himanni kun fi hidhaan hogganoota mormituu irratti raawwatame biyyattii keessaatti tasgabbii dhabuu uumeera.

title: Iran’s hardline parliament raises concerns with ‘foreign infiltration’ plan
english: Iran's hardline parliament has advanced a new bill aimed at curbing 'foreign infiltration' by imposing strict regulations on interactions with international entities. If enacted, citizens and organizations would require official government approval to engage in activities like academic research, media interviews, or collaboration with foreign institutions. Critics and public members have expressed significant alarm, fearing that the legislation will severely restrict personal freedoms and tighten state control over various professional and cultural sectors.
amharic: የኢራን ጠንካራ አቋም ያለው ፓርላማ ከውጭ ኃይሎች የሚመጣን ተፅዕኖ ለመከላከል በሚል አዲስ ረቂቅ ህግ አዘጋጅቷል። ይህ ህግ ተግባራዊ ከሆነ ዜጎችና የተለያዩ ተቋማት ከውጭ ሀገራት ጋር ለሚያደርጉት የትምህርት፣ የምርምር እና የሚዲያ ስራዎች የመንግስት ፍቃድ እንዲኖራቸው ይጠይቃል። ህጉ የግለሰቦችን ነፃነት የሚገድብ እና በመንግስት በኩል ያለውን ቁጥጥር የሚያጠናክር በመሆኑ በህዝቡና በተለያዩ ወገኖች ዘንድ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Iraan kan harka qabaatan of harkaa qaban, dhiibbaa biyyoota alaa ittisuuf jechuun seera haaraa tokko raggaasisuuf ka'aniiru. Seerri kun yoo mirkanaa'e, lammiileen fi dhaabbileen barnoota, qorannoo ykn ogeeyyota miidiyaa biyya alaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya uumuuf eeyyama mootummaa argachuu qabu. Seerichi mirga dhuunfaa kan dhorkuufi too'annoo mootummaa kan jabeessu ta'uun isaa, ummata fi ogeeyyota biratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Ethiopia’s National Dialogue Could Unravel the Federal Bargain
english: Ethiopia has launched a national dialogue involving thousands of participants, aiming to address the country's political future. However, many in the Somali Region are concerned that this process could be used to weaken the current federal system and the constitutional protections that ensure their self-determination. While Somalis feel the existing federal model has not been implemented fairly, they remain wary of any changes that might further centralize power and reduce regional autonomy.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር ጉባኤ የጀመረች ሲሆን በውስጡም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተሳታፊዎችን አካቷል። ነገር ግን በሶማሌ ክልል የሚገኙ ብዙዎች ይህ ሂደት የፌዴራል ስርአቱን እና የክልሉን የራስን እድል በራስ የመወሰን መብት ለመሸርሸር ሊያገለግል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የሶማሌ ክልል ነዋሪዎች ያለው የፌዴራል ስርአት በአግባቡ እየተተገበረ አይደለም ብለው ቢያምኑም፣ ስልጣንን ማዕከል በሚያደርግ እና የክልል ነጻነትን በሚገድብ ማናቸውም ለውጥ ላይ ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ አላቸው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan marii biyyoolessaa hirmaattota kumaan lakkaa'aman hammate tokko kan jalqabde yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas gara fuulduraatti rakkoolee biyyattii furuudha. Ta'us, naannoo Somaalee keessatti namoonni baay'een mariin kun sirna federaalaa fi mirga ofiin of bulchuu kan kabachiisu seera bu'uuraa laaffisuuf kan oolu ta'uu danda'a jedhanii shakkidu. Ummanni Somaalee sirni federaalaa amma jiru qabatamaan akka hin hojjenne kan amanan ta'us, humni gara giddugaleessaatti akka cimuufi mirgi naannolee akka xiqqaatu kan godhu jijjiirama kamiyyuu mormu.

title: Canada pledges $50m aid to Lebanon and condemns Israeli ‘unlawful invasion’
english: Canada has promised $50 million in humanitarian aid to support Lebanese families affected by the ongoing conflict. During his visit to the region, Canadian official Randeep Sarai strongly criticized Israel’s military presence in Lebanon as an unlawful invasion and emphasized the importance of restoring Lebanese sovereignty. The conflict has caused significant displacement and loss of life, and Canada remains committed to providing long-term support for those impacted by the violence.
amharic: ካናዳ በሊባኖስ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ለተጎዱ ቤተሰቦች የሚውል የ50 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እንደምትሰጥ ቃል ገብታለች። የካናዳ ባለስልጣን ራንዲፕ ሳራይ በክልሉ ባደረጉት ጉብኝት የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ህገ-ወጥ ወረራ ሲሉ አውግዘው፣ የሊባኖስ ሉዓላዊነት መጠበቅ እንዳለበት አሳስበዋል። ግጭቱ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና መፈናቀል ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ካናዳም ለተጎጂዎች የረጅም ጊዜ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Kaanaadaan waraana Liibaanoos keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoota miidhaman gargaaruuf qarshii miliyoona 50 gumaachuu waadaa galteetti. Aangawaan Kaanaadaa Randeep Saaraay naannichatti erga daawwatanii booda, tarkaanfii waraana Israa'el akka seeraan alaa ta'etti balaaleffachuun, bilisummaan Liibaanoos kabajamuu qaba jedhaniiru. Waraanni kun lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafatee fi buqqaatii guddaa kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, Kaanaadaan gargaarsa dheeraa fi itti fufiinsa qabu gochuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Kennedy Center board says it won’t try to immediately restore Trump’s name
english: The Kennedy Center board has agreed to pause plans to put Donald Trump’s name back on the building until at least September 8. This follows a legal conflict regarding a federal court order that previously demanded the removal of his name because only Congress has the authority to change the venue's branding. Critics remain concerned that the board is trying to find ways to honor the president despite ongoing legal challenges regarding the center's status as a memorial to John F. Kennedy.
amharic: የኬኔዲ ማዕከል ቦርድ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን ስም በህንጻው ላይ የመመለስ እቅዳቸውን ቢያንስ እስከ መስከረም 8 ድረስ እንደሚያቆሙ አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የሕንጻውን ስም መቀየር የሚችለው የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኮንግረስ ብቻ ነው በሚል ቀደም ሲል የተሰጠውን የፍርድ ቤት ትዕዛዝ ተከትሎ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ተቺዎች ቦርዱ የጆን ኤፍ ኬኔዲ መታሰቢያ የሆነውን ይህንን ቦታ በፕሬዝዳንቱ ስም ለመሰየም አሁንም ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው በማለት ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Boordiin Kennedy Center, maqaa Donald Trump iddoo sana irra deebisee kaa'uuf karoorfate hanga Fulbaana 8tti akka hin raawwanne beeksiseera. Murteen kun kan dhufe, maqaan kun kan jijjiiramu qabu aangoo Kongireesii qofaan akka ta'e ajaja mana murtii duraan darbeen wal-qabatee dha. Ta'us, qaamoleen mormii qaban boordichi iddoo yaadannoo John F. Kennedy kana maqaa pirezidaantichaatiin moggaasuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiraachuu isaatti yaaddoo qabu.

title: Brazil bus crash kills at least 23 and injures five in Parana state
english: At least 23 people died and five were injured when a minibus carrying patients to a hospital collided with a truck in southern Brazil. The accident happened in Parana state after the truck reportedly veered into the opposite lane. The regional governor has declared three days of mourning to honor the victims of this tragic event.
amharic: በብራዚል ፓራና ግዛት ታማሚዎችን ወደ ሆስፒታል ይዞ ሲጓዝ የነበረ ሚኒባስ ከጭነት መኪና ጋር በመጋጨቱ ቢያንስ 23 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል አምስቱ ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የጭነት መኪናው ወደ ተቃራኒው መስመር በመግባቱ እንደተከሰተ የመጀመሪያ መረጃዎች ያመለክታሉ። የክልሉ አስተዳደር ለሟቾች መታሰቢያ የሶስት ቀን የሀዘን ቀንን አውጇል።
oromo: Braazil keessatti namoonni 23 ta'an erga miidhaan irra gahee du'anii, shan immoo madaa'aniiru. Kunis konkolaataan busii tokko kan dhukkubsattoota gara mana yaalaatti fe'ee deemaa ture, konkolaata gurguddaa biraa wajjin walitti bu'uu irraan kan ka'e kan uumameedha. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, konkolaataan gurguddaan sun gara karaa busichi itti deemaa turetti gombifamuun isaa balaa kana fide. Mootummaan naannichaa balaa kana ilaalchisee guyyoota sadiif gadda biyyaalessaa labseera.

title: NATO ‘prepared’ to defend allies amid report of Iranian strike plans
english: NATO has announced it is ready to protect its member states following reports that Iran might be planning attacks against U.S. military sites in Europe. In response to these concerns, Bulgaria has boosted security at the Bezmer Air Base, which currently hosts U.S. personnel. NATO officials stated they are prepared to take any necessary action to maintain defense and security across the alliance.
amharic: ኢራን በአውሮፓ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር እያቀደች ነው የሚለውን ዘገባ ተከትሎ፣ ኔቶ የአባል ሀገራቱን ለመከላከል ዝግጁ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ይህንን ስጋት ተከትሎ ቡልጋሪያ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በሚገኙበት የቤዝመር አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥብቅ የደህንነት እርምጃዎችን ጨምራለች። የኔቶ ባለስልጣናት ህብረቱ የባልደረባ ሀገራቱን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ አስፈላጊውን ሁሉ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Iiraan buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kan Awurooppaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfachuu ishee gabaasni tokko erga ibsee booda, dhaabbanni NATO biyyoota miseensa isaa ittisuuf qophiirra jiraachuu beeksiseera. Sodaa kana hordofee, biyyi Bulgaariyaa buufata xiyyaaraa Bezmer kan waraanni Ameerikaa keessa jiran irratti eegumsa cimaa gooteetti. Hojjettoonni NATO gamtaan kun nageenya miseensota isaa kabachiisuuf tarkaanfii barbaachisaa ta'e hunda fudhachuuf qophii ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US Department of Justice defends prosecution of Comey over seashell post
english: The U.S. Department of Justice is upholding its legal case against former FBI Director James Comey regarding a social media post featuring seashells arranged as '86 47.' Prosecutors argue this image served as a coded death threat against President Donald Trump and claim Comey used the controversy to generate publicity for his upcoming book. Comey’s defense team maintains the post was innocent, arguing that '86' is a common slang term for removing someone rather than a violent ultimatum.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በቀድሞው የኤፍቢአይ ዳይሬክተር ጄምስ ኮሚ ላይ የመሰረተውን ክስ አፅንኦት ሰጥቶበታል። ክሱ ኮሚ በኢንስታግራም ላይ የባህር ዛጎሎችን በመጠቀም '86 47' በሚል ቁጥር የለቀቁት ምስል በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ላይ የተሰነዘረ የዛቻ መልእክት ነው በሚል ነው። የኮሚ ጠበቆች ምስሉ ምንም አይነት የጥቃት መልእክት እንደሌለው እና '86' የሚለው አገላለጽ አንድን ሰው ለማስወገድ ወይም ለማባረር የሚጠቅም ተራ ቋንቋ እንጂ የዛቻ እንዳልሆነ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Manni maree haqaa Amerikaa himata duraanii daayrektara FBI James Comey irratti dhiyaate kan cimsatan yoo ta'u, kunis fakkii qola galaanaa '86 47' jedhamee Instagram irratti maxxansamee wajjin wal qabata. Abbootiin seeraa fakkichi Preezidaant Donald Traamp irratti ajjeechaa kan akeekuudha jedhanii himatu, akkasumas Comey walitti bu'iinsa kana bu'uura godhatee kitaaba isaa haaraa gurgurachuu barbaade jedhanii dubbatu. Gareen abukaattoota Comey garuu, '86' jechuun jecha namoota hojii irraa ari'uuf ykn itti fayyadamuu dhabuuf itti himamu malee, sodaachisaa miti jedhanii mormu.

title: North Korea leader’s sister denies talks with ‘hostile’ US
english: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, has rejected recent claims by US President Donald Trump that he is in communication with her brother. While Trump stated he had positive interactions regarding potential talks, Kim Yo Jong maintained that no such dialogue is happening and accused the US of maintaining a hostile stance. This disagreement highlights the ongoing diplomatic tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን እህት ኪም ዮ ጆንግ፣ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከወንድሟ ጋር ግንኙነት እንዳላቸው የገለጹትን መግለጫ አስተባበሉ። ትራምፕ ስለ ውይይት አወንታዊ ንግግሮች እንደነበሩ ቢናገሩም፣ ኪም ዮ ጆንግ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ምንም አይነት ግንኙነት እንደሌለ ገልጸው አሜሪካ በሀገራቸው ላይ ጠላትነት የተሞላበት አካሄድ እንደያዘች ወቅሰዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረት በግልጽ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Obboleettiin hoogganaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un, Kim Yo Jong, ibsa prezidaantii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp kan isaan obboleessa ishee waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban jedhan haalteetti. Tiraamp marii danda'amu ilaalchisee haasaa gaarii akka qaban dubbatulle, Kim Yo Jong mariin akkasii hin jiru jechuun Ameerikaan ilaalcha diinummaa qabdi jechuun himatteetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun waldhabdee dipilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan ifa godhu dha.

title: Israeli soldier visiting India accused of war crimes in Gaza's Khan Younis
english: The Hind Rajab Foundation has submitted a legal complaint in India against an Israeli soldier who is accused of committing war crimes in Gaza. The organization alleges that the soldier participated in the intentional destruction of civilian homes in the Khan Younis area. This marks the second time the group has taken such action against an Israeli military member currently traveling within India.
amharic: የሂንድ ራጃብ ፋውንዴሽን በጋዛ የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽሟል በሚል በአንድ እስራኤላዊ ወታደር ላይ በህንድ የህግ ክስ መስርቷል። ድርጅቱ ወታደሩ በካን ዩኒስ አካባቢ የሲቪል መኖሪያ ቤቶችን ሆን ብሎ በማውደም ድርጊት ተሳትፏል ሲል ይከሳል። ይህም ቡድኑ በአሁኑ ወቅት በህንድ ውስጥ በሚገኝ የእስራኤል ወታደር ላይ የህግ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ የሞከረበት ሁለተኛው አጋጣሚ ነው።
oromo: Hundeen Hind Rajab jedhamu waraana Israa'el tokko irratti himata yakka waraanaa Hindii keessatti dhiyeesseera. Dhaabbatichi waraanni kun naannoo Khan Yunisitti manneen jireenyaa namoota nagaa ta’anii akkaataa karooraan barbadeessuu isaa himata. Kunis gareen kun waraana Israa'el kan yeroo ammaa Hindii keessa jiru tokko irratti yeroo lammaffaaf tarkaanfii seeraa fudhatuudha.

title: Israeli soldier visiting India accused of war crimes in Gaza's Khan Younis
english: The Hind Rajab Foundation has submitted a formal complaint in India against an unidentified Israeli soldier suspected of committing war crimes, including the intentional destruction of civilian property in Gaza. This follows a previous, unsuccessful attempt to hold another soldier accountable for similar actions earlier this year. Human rights lawyers argue that India is legally obligated under international law to investigate these allegations rather than allowing accused individuals to visit the country without consequence.
amharic: የሂንድ ራጃብ ፋውንዴሽን በጋዛ የሲቪል ንብረቶችን ሆን ብሎ በማውደም የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽሟል ተብሎ በተጠረጠረ አንድ የእስራኤል ወታደር ላይ በህንድ አገር ክስ መስርቷል። ፋውንዴሽኑ ከዚህ ቀደም በተመሳሳይ ድርጊት ተሳታፊ የሆኑ ወታደሮችን ተጠያቂ ለማድረግ ቢሞክርም ውጤታማ አልነበረም። የሰብአዊ መብት ጠበቆች እንደሚያሳስቡት ህንድ በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት የተጠረጠሩ ግለሰቦች ያለምንም ተጠያቂነት ወደ አገሯ እንዳይገቡ የመመርመር ግዴታ እንዳለባት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hundeen Hind Rajab jedhamu waraana Israa'el tokko kan maqaan isaa hin ibsamne irratti, qabeenya sivilii Gaazaa keessatti beekaa balleessuu dabalatee yakka waraanaa raawwate jechuun Indiyaatti himata dhiyeesseera. Waldaan kun kanaan dura waraana biraa irratti himata wal-fakkaatu dhiyeessee ture. Looyyoonni mirga namoomaa akka jedhanitti, Indiyaan seera idil-addunyaatiin dirqama qabdi; kanaafuu namoota yakka waraanaa keessatti shakkaman gara biyyattii yeroo dhufanitti akka qorataman malee, himata malee akka hin darbine gaafataniiru.

title: ICC says US sanctions a 'flagrant attack' on court independence
english: The International Criminal Court has condemned recent US sanctions against its president and a senior lawyer, labeling the move a direct assault on the institution's independence. Washington claims the court is politically motivated, but the ICC, alongside officials from the EU, UN, and various nations, rejects these accusations. These international leaders are calling for the immediate removal of the sanctions, emphasizing that the court must be free from outside interference to function properly.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በፕሬዝዳንቱ እና በአንድ የህግ ባለሙያ ላይ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የጣለውን ማዕቀብ የፍርድ ቤቱን ነጻነት የሚጋፋ አደገኛ ተግባር ሲል ኮንኖታል። ዋሽንግተን ፍርድ ቤቱን በፖለቲካ የተጠላለፈ ነው ብላ ብትከስም፣ የአውሮፓ ህብረት፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት እና ሌሎች ሀገራት ውሳኔውን በመቃወም ድጋፋቸውን ለፍርድ ቤቱ ሰጥተዋል። እነዚህ ዓለም አቀፍ አካላት ፍርድ ቤቱ ያለ ምንም ውጫዊ ተጽዕኖ ስራውን እንዲቀጥል ማዕቀቡ በአስቸኳይ እንዲነሳ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Addunyaa (ICC) mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii isaa fi gorsaa seeraa tokko irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhachuu isaa, walaba ta'uu mana murtichaa irratti haleellaa bal'aa jechuun balaaleffateera. Ameerikaan mana murtichaa siyaasaan kan guutame fi malaamaltummaa keessa kan jiru jechuun himattuus, gamtaan Awurooppaa, mootummoota gamtoomaniifi biyyoonni hedduun murtii kana mormaniiru. Hogganoonni idil-addunyaa kunneen, mana murtichi dhiibbaa alaa tokko malee hojii isaa akka gaggeeffatuuf, sanadoonni kunneen hatattamaan akka kaafaman gaafataniiru.

title: Hamas condemns ‘new war crime’ as Israel kills 10 in crowded Gaza hubs
english: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least ten Palestinians, including police officials and civilians, across two separate locations. While Israel claims the attacks targeted Hamas commanders, Hamas has dismissed these allegations as false and labeled the actions as war crimes against unarmed people. These incidents have further escalated tensions and sparked intense criticism regarding the impact of the ongoing military operations on Gaza's civilian population.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ ሁለት ተከታታይ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ አስር ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን ያነጣጠረችው በሃማስ አዛዦች ላይ እንደሆነ ብትገልጽም፣ ሃማስ ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ ድርጊቱን የጦር ወንጀል ሲል አውግዞታል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በጋዛ የሚገኙ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ላይ እያደረሱ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ተከትሎ ውጥረቱ አሁንም ተባብሶ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel magaala Gaza keessatti iddoowwan lama adda addaatti weerara qilleensaatiin raawwateen namootni Falasxiin 10 ol ta'an du'aniiru. Israa'eel tarkaanfiin kun ajootoota Haamaas irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsituus, qaamni Haamaas himannaa kana dhara jechuun yakka waraanaa jechuun balaaleffateera. Weerara kanaan lubbuun namoota nagaa fi poolisootaa darbuun isaa rakkoo fi walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa caalmaatti hammeesseera.

title: US pressure on Israel needed for peace in Syria
english: Following a recent Israeli airstrike on a Syrian airbase, a US official has proposed a diplomatic deconfliction mechanism to stabilize the region. However, experts argue that such efforts remain ineffective because Israel continues to launch regular military attacks despite Syria's transition to a new government. Analysts suggest that significant pressure from the United States is essential to compel Israel to prioritize peace and halt its ongoing hostilities.
amharic: በቅርቡ በእስራኤል በሶሪያ ላይ በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ሳቢያ፣ አንድ የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት በሶሪያ፣ በቱርክ እና በእስራኤል መካከል ውጥረትን የሚቀንስ የድርድር ማዕቀፍ እንዲፈጠር ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ እስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቷን የምትቀጥል ከሆነ ይህ ጥረት ውጤታማ ሊሆን አይችልም። እስራኤል ከሶሪያ ጋር የሰላም ውይይት እንድትጀምር የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ጠንካራ ጫና ማሳደር እንዳለበት ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።

title: US and Canada reach ‘very fair’ trade agreement, Trump says
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States and Canada have reached a fair trade agreement to eliminate tariffs on various goods. This deal follows a temporary pause on significant taxes that were set to impact billions of dollars in imports. While discussions regarding specific sectors like the automotive industry continue, both nations are working to finalize the details of this new economic partnership.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ እና ካናዳ በንግድ ዕቃዎች ላይ የሚጣል የጉምሩክ ቀረጥን ለማስወገድ የሚያስችል ፍትሃዊ ስምምነት ላይ መድረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ስምምነት በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዶላሮች ዋጋ ባላቸው ምርቶች ላይ ሊጣል የነበረው ከፍተኛ ቀረጥ ለጊዜው እንዲቆም አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን በአውቶሞቲቭ ዘርፍ ዙሪያ የሚደረጉ ድርድሮች አሁንም ቢቀጥሉም፣ ሁለቱ አገራት ስምምነቱን በይፋ ለማጠናቀቅ እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp fi biyyooti Ameerikaa fi Kaanaadaa, meeshaalee daldala irratti gibira kaffaltii (tariffs) haquuf walii galtee haqa qabeessa ta’e tokko irra gahuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Walii galteen kun meeshaalee biiliyoonaan lakkaa’aman irratti gibirri guddaan akka hin buune daangessuuf gargaara. Haaluma kanaan, waliigalteen kun xumura argachuuf hojiin bal’aan kan hafe ta’us, damee konkolaataa dabalatee dhimmoota biroorratti mariin itti fufee jira.

title: Why extreme heat is much more dangerous for the elderly than we realised
english: A recent Stanford study reveals that extreme heat is significantly more dangerous for older adults because their bodies struggle to cool down compared to younger people. As the global population of those over 60 increases, researchers warn that existing heat safety standards, which often assume universal tolerance, severely underestimate the risks. The findings show that elderly individuals reach dangerous heat stress levels much faster, making them highly vulnerable to illness or death as global temperatures continue to rise.
amharic: የስታንፎርድ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ተመራማሪዎች ባደረጉት ጥናት፣ ከባድ ሙቀት ለአረጋውያን ከታሰበው በላይ እጅግ አደገኛ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። አረጋውያን ዕድሜያቸው እየገፋ ሲሄድ ሰውነታቸው ራሱን የማቀዝቀዝ አቅሙ ስለሚቀንስ ለሙቀት ተጽዕኖ በቀላሉ ይጋለጣሉ። ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የሙቀት መለኪያ መስፈርቶች ለሁሉም የዕድሜ ክልል ተመሳሳይ መቻቻል እንዳላቸው በመገመት ስህተት ይሠሩ እንደነበር ጥናቱ አመልክቷል። ዓለም አቀፍ የሙቀት መጠን እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ፣ ይህ የተጋላጭነት ሁኔታ በአረጋውያን ላይ ለከባድ የጤና ችግር እና ለሞት የመዳረግ አደጋን በእጅጉ ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Qorannoon yuunivarsiitii Stanford akka agarsiisutti, namoonni dulloomanii fi umriin isaanii ol ta'e haala qilleensa hoo'a guddaa keessatti fayyaadhaan miidhamuuf carraa guddaa qabu. Umriin erga dabaree booda qaamni namaa of-qabbaneessuuf dandeettii xiqqoo qabaachuu isaatiin, namoonni umriin isaanii waggaa 60 oli ta'an dhukkubaaf saaxilamoo ta'u. Qorannoon kun akka ibsutti, sirni dursaa qilleensa hoo'a safaruuf fayyadamuun namoota hunda dandeettii tokko qabu jennee yaaduun dogoggoraa fi namoota dullooman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisuu danda'a. Hoo'i lafaa dabalaa waan jiruuf, namoonni dullooman kun balaa lubbuu fi fayyaa keessa akka jiran qorannichi akeekkachiiseera.

title: Israel opens up tenders for controversial West Bank settlement project
english: The Israeli government has initiated a bidding process to build over 1,200 new housing units in the E1 area of the occupied West Bank. This project is highly controversial because it would physically separate the West Bank and isolate East Jerusalem, creating a major obstacle to the establishment of a future Palestinian state. International law considers these settlements illegal, yet the current government continues to push for expansion despite widespread global opposition.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግስት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በኢ1 (E1) አካባቢ ከ1,200 በላይ አዳዲስ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ጨረታ አውጥቷል። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ዌስት ባንክን ለሁለት የሚከፍል እና ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌምን ከሌሎች የፍልስጤም አካባቢዎች የሚለይ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች ህገ-ወጥ ቢሆኑም፣ የእስራኤል መንግስት የሁለት ሀገር መፍትሄን ለማምከን በሚል የግንባታ ስራውን በስፋት እየገፋበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Qaqqabbiin (West Bank) keessatti bakka E1 jedhamutti mana jireenyaa 1,200 ol ijaaruuf carra qorannoo dorgommii baneera. Karoorri kun Qaqqabbiin bakka lamatti hiruu fi magaalaa Yerusaalem Bahaa addaan baasuu danda'uuf, furmaata biyya lammeessuu (two-state solution) gufachiisa jedhamee mormameera. Seerawwan idil-addunyaa irratti hundaa'uun manneen ijaaramu kun seeraan alaa ta'us, mootummaan Israa'el haala kanaan babal'isuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: Report: Israeli settlers seize near-total control of Ramallah village land
english: Israeli settlers have seized nearly all the land belonging to the Palestinian village of Um al-Safa near Ramallah, destroying local olive trees and building new unauthorized outposts. Residents are facing severe restrictions, including being blocked from their own cemetery, forcing them to bury family members on private property. The expansion of these settlements has effectively displaced the local community from their agricultural lands.
amharic: ራማላህ አቅራቢያ የምትገኘው የኡም አል-ሳፋ መንደር ነዋሪዎች ከሞላ ጎደል መሬታቸውን በኢስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች ተነጥቀዋል። ሰፋሪዎቹ የነዋሪዎቹን የኑሮ መሰረት የሆኑትን የወይራ ዛፎች በመንቀል ህገ-ወጥ ግንባታዎችን እያከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹ መቃብራቸውንም እንዳይጠቀሙ በመከልከላቸው ቤተሰቦቻቸውን በቤት ውስጥ እንዲቀብሩ ተገደዋል። ይህ የሰፈራ መስፋፋት የአካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ከቀዬአቸው እያፈናቀላቸው ይገኛል።

Jiraattonni iddoo awwaalchaa isaanii illee akka hin fayyadamne waan dhoorkamaniif, namoota du'an mana keessatti awwaaluuf dirqamaniiru.
