title: India rout Pakistan at Hockey World Cup 2026 to qualify for second round
english: India secured a spot in the second round of the 2026 Hockey World Cup by defeating Pakistan 5-3 in a high-stakes group stage match. Despite playing with only 10 men during the final minutes, the Indian team maintained their lead to finish second in Pool D behind England. This defeat eliminates Pakistan from the tournament, while India now prepares for their upcoming challenge against the Netherlands.
amharic: በ2026 የሆኪ ዓለም ዋንጫ ህንድ ፓኪስታንን 5 ለ 3 በማሸነፍ ወደ ሁለተኛው ዙር ማለፏን አረጋግጣለች። የህንድ ቡድን በጨዋታው የመጨረሻ ደቂቃዎች በአስር ተጫዋቾች ብቻ ቢጫወቱም ውጤቱን ጠብቀው በመቆየት በምድብ ዲ ከእንግሊዝ በመቀጠል ሁለተኛ ደረጃን ይዘው ማጠናቀቅ ችለዋል። ይህ ውጤት ፓኪስታንን ከውድድሩ ውጪ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ህንድ በቀጣይ ከኔዘርላንድስ ጋር ለመጫወት ተዘጋጅታለች።
oromo: Indiyaa tapha waancaa addunyaa hoki 2026 irratti Paakistaan 5-3 injifachuun gara sadarkaa lammaffaatti darbuu ishee mirkaneeffatteetti. Gareen Indiyaa yeroo xumuraa irratti taphattoota 10 qofa ta'anii taphatanis, dursanii goolii galchan eeggachuun garee Pool D keessatti Itoophiyaa itti aansuun sadarkaa lammaffaa irratti xumuruu danda'aniiru. Injifannoon kun Paakistaan dorgommicha irraa akka baatu kan godhe yoo ta'u, Indiyaan immoo gara fuulduraatti Nezerlaandii waliin taphachuuf qophiirra jirti.

title: Seven decades of US regime change efforts: What have they achieved?
english: For over seventy years, the United States has frequently attempted to overthrow foreign governments that conflict with its interests, with the 1953 coup in Iran serving as a notable historical example. Currently, Washington and its allies are engaged in a significant military conflict with Tehran, which has disrupted global energy supplies and sparked regional instability. These recurring interventions often result in immense financial burdens and human suffering without consistently achieving long-term American policy goals.
amharic: ለሰባ ዓመታት ያህል፣ አሜሪካ ከእሷ ፍላጎት ጋር የሚቃረኑ የውጭ ሀገር መንግሥታትን ለመገልበጥ በተደጋጋሚ ስትሞክር ቆይታለች፤ በ1953 በኢራን የተካሄደው መፈንቅለ መንግሥት ለዚህ ዋና ምሳሌ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ዋሽንግተን እና አጋሮቿ ከኢራን ጋር በከባድ ወታደራዊ ግጭት ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል እና ለቀጠናዊ አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ሆኗል። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጣልቃ ገብነቶች የአሜሪካን የረጅም ጊዜ ግቦች ሳያሳኩ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ኪሳራ እና የሰው ሕይወት መጥፋት እያስከተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Amerika waggoota torbaatamii oluf fedhii ishee waliin kan wal-hin simne mootummoota biyya alaa fonqolchuuf yeroo baay'ee yaaltee jirti; fonqolchi bara 1953 biyya Iran keessatti gaggeeffame fakkeenya guddaa kanaaf ta'a. Yeroo ammaa kana, Washington fi michoonni ishee Iran waliin waraana cimaa keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, kunis dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa irratti rakkoo uumee fi naannichatti tasgabbii dhabuu fideera. Jiddu-seentummaan irra deddeebi'ame kun galma siyaasaa Amerikaa kan hin milkeessine ta'us, baasii maallaqaa guddaa fi miidhaa lubbuu namootaa irratti kan fideedha.

title: Israel admits firing on car carrying Hind Rajab, symbol of Gaza’s suffering
english: The Israeli military has officially acknowledged firing on a vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza, an incident that occurred over two years ago. While the army has now launched a criminal investigation citing failures in movement coordination, they previously denied any presence in the area. The child was killed alongside her family members after being trapped in their car, and despite these new developments, critics remain skeptical that the internal probe will lead to true accountability.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከሁለት ዓመት በፊት በጋዛ አምስት ዓመቷን ሂንድ ራጃብ የያዘች መኪና ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አምኗል። ቀደም ሲል በቦታው እንዳልነበሩ ሲክዱ የቆዩት እስራኤላውያን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የቅንጅት ስህተት እንደነበር በመጥቀስ የወንጀል ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ህጻኗ ከቤተሰቦቿ ጋር በመኪና ውስጥ ተገድባ በነበረበት ወቅት የተፈጸመው ይህ አሰቃቂ ድርጊት አለም አቀፍ ድምጽ ቢኖረውም፣ አሁን የተጀመረው ምርመራ ተጠያቂነትን ያስገኛል የሚለው ጥርጣሬ አሁንም አለ።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el waggoota lama dura magaalaa Gaazaa keessatti mucayyoo umriin ishee shan Hind Raajab itti ajjeefamte konkolaataa ishee irratti dhukaasuu isaa yeroo jalqabaaf amaneera. Kanaan dura bakka sana akka hin turre haalaa turanillee, amma garuu dogoggora qindoominaa sababeeffachuun qorannoo yakkaa jalqabuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Mucayyoon tun maatii ishee waliin konkolaataa keessatti qabamtee kan ajjeefamte yoo ta'u, qorannoon amma jalqabame kun haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaa fida jedhamee hin eeggamu.

title: France says settler violence justifies its sanctions against Israeli minister Ben Gvir
english: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot has officially defended France's decision to sanction Israeli minister Itamar Ben Gvir due to his unacceptable rhetoric and the ongoing violence by settlers against Palestinians. The French government emphasized that such actions in the West Bank are morally reprehensible and have led to a travel ban against the minister. Furthermore, officials indicated that additional measures may be taken against other individuals and groups involved in perpetuating regional violence.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዣን-ኖኤል ባሮት፣ እስራኤላዊው ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በሰጡት ተቀባይነት የሌለው አስተያየት እና በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት ተባባሪ በመሆናቸው ፈረንሳይ በእሳቸው ላይ ማዕቀብ መጣሏን ተከላከሉ። የፈረንሳይ መንግስት በምዕራብ ባንክ እየተፈጸመ ያለው ድርጊት አስነዋሪ መሆኑን ገልጾ፣ ሚኒስትሩ ወደ ፈረንሳይ እንዳይገቡ መከልከሉን አስታውቋል። በቀጣይም በክልሉ ሁከት በሚቀሰቅሱ አካላት ላይ ተጨማሪ ማዕቀቦች ሊወሰዱ እንደሚችሉ ሚኒስትሩ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Faransaay Jean-Noel Barrot, gochaan ministira Israa'eel Itamar Ben Gvir fi haleellaan jiraattota Israa'eel namoota Falasxiin irratti raawwatamu fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uu ibsuun, Faransaay isaanii irratti tarkaanfii sanadaa fudhachuu ishee deeggaran. Mootummaan Faransaay gochi naannoo Baanki Dhihaa keessatti raawwatamu kan nama gaddisiisu fi jibisiisu ta'uu ibsuun, ministirichi biyya Faransaay akka hin seenne dhorkameera. Kana malees, qaamolee naannichatti jeequmsa uuman irratti gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfiin dabalataa fudhatamuu akka danda'u himameera.

title: Israel admits that it fired on vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab
english: The Israeli military has officially acknowledged firing on a vehicle carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab and her family in Gaza back in early 2024. Despite coordinating a rescue mission, Israeli forces also attacked the ambulance sent to save the young girl, resulting in the deaths of Hind, her family members, and the two responding paramedics. Following this admission, the military has announced plans to launch a criminal investigation into the incident.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በፈረንጆቹ 2024 መጀመሪያ ላይ በጋዛ የ5 ዓመቷን ሂንድ ራጃብን እና ቤተሰቧን የያዘ ተሽከርካሪ ላይ መተኮሱን ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ አምኗል። ለሂንድ መዳን የተላከው አምቡላንስ ከእስራኤል ጦር ጋር ተቀናጅቶ የሄደ ቢሆንም በዚሁ ጦር ጥቃት ደርሶበት ሂንድን፣ የቤተሰቧን አባላት እና ሁለት የህክምና ባለሙያዎችን ለሞት ዳርጓል። ይህንን ተከትሎ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አመራር በጉዳዩ ላይ የወንጀል ምርመራ እንደሚከፍት አስታውቋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el bara 2024 jalqaba irratti magaalaa Gaazaatti mucayyoo umriin ishee waggaa shanii Hind Raajaab fi maatii ishee kan turan konkolaataa irratti dhukaasuusaa jalqabaaf amaneera. Hind oolchuuf gargaarsi yaala hatattamaa qindeeffannoo waraana Israa'el waliin ergame kan turus, waraanni sunumaan reebamuun Hind, miseensota maatii ishee fi ogeeyyota fayyaa lama ajjeeseera. Himannoo kana hordofee, waraanni Israa'el dhimma kana irratti qorannoo yakkaa akka banu beeksisera.

title: Israel’s Ben Gvir boasts of planned execution facility for Palestinian prisoners
english: Israel's National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has announced plans to build a facility specifically for executing Palestinian prisoners. In a social media video, he described the site as featuring viewing rooms where victims of crimes can witness the hangings. This announcement marks a significant development in his stated commitment to implementing capital punishment for those labeled as terrorists.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞችን ለመግደል የሚያገለግል ማዕከል እየገነቡ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በለቀቁት ቪዲዮ መሰረት፣ ቦታው የጥቃት ሰለባ የሆኑ ሰዎች የግድያ ሂደቱን የሚመለከቱበት ክፍል እንደሚኖረው ተናግረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ አሸባሪ ተብለው በተፈረጁ እስረኞች ላይ የሞት ቅጣት ለመጣል የገቡትን ቃል ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ የታቀደ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri nageenya biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamar Ben Gviir, hidhattoota Falasxiim ajjeesuuf giddugala addaa ijaaraa jiraachuu isaanii ifoomsaniiru. Viidiyoo miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti baasan keessatti, bakki kun miidhamtoonni gocha yakkaatiin miidhaman ajjeechaa kana akka ilaalan iddoo addaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun namoota shororkeessitoota jedhamaniin irratti adabbii du'aa raawwachuuf waadaa galan hojii irra oolchuuf kan kaayyeffate dha.

title: Addis Abeba Builds Over Its Waterways. Now the Floods Find a Way Back
english: An 11-year-old boy named Simon Nahom went missing after falling into an uncovered, flooded drainage channel in Addis Ababa's Jemo neighborhood. Despite extensive search efforts by authorities and community members stretching to the Aba Samuel Dam, he has not been found. This tragedy highlights a systemic failure in urban planning, where improper construction over waterways has made the city increasingly vulnerable to dangerous flooding.
amharic: ሲሞን ናሆም የተባለ የ11 ዓመት ህጻን በአዲስ አበባ ጀሞ አካባቢ በጎርፍ የተሸፈነ ክፍት የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃ ውስጥ በመውደቁ እስካሁን የደረሰበት አልታወቀም። ባለሥልጣናት እና የአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ እስከ አባ ሳሙኤል ግድብ ድረስ ሰፊ ፍለጋ ቢያደርጉም ህጻኑን ማግኘት አልቻሉም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በከተማዋ የውሃ መስመሮች ላይ በተገነቡ ህገ-ወጥ ግንባታዎች እና በተበላሸ የመሠረተ ልማት ዲዛይን ሳቢያ ለጎርፍ አደጋዎች የመጋለጥ ችግር ምን ያህል አሳሳቢ እንደሆነ ያሳያል።
oromo: Mucaan umriin isaa waggaa 11 ta'e Siimon Naahom jedhamu, naannoo Jemo Finfinneetti bishaan lolaa jala dhokate keessatti kufuun erga baddee guyyoota hedduu lakkoofsiiseera. Mootummaan fi uummanni iddoo gara garaatti, hanga hidha Aba Saamu'elitti barbaacha bal'aa taasisanis mucicha argachuu hin dandeenye. Balaan kun rakkoo qindoomina magaalaa fi bishaan dhangala'aa irratti ijaarsa seeraan alaa gaggeeffamuun lolaa fi balaa hammeessuun isaa hubatameera.

title: Ethio-post Turns Branches into Banks as Banks Close Theirs
english: Ethio-post is transforming its 3,000 nationwide branches into banking service centers to allow customers to perform transactions like deposits, withdrawals, and bill payments for any commercial bank. The state-owned postal service has already launched a pilot program at 700 locations in partnership with EthSwitch and plans a full rollout within a month. This strategic shift aims to modernize the historic organization and boost its revenue as it navigates declining profits despite increased operational volume.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ ፖስት በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የሚገኙ 3,000 ቅርንጫፎቹን የባንክ አገልግሎት መስጫ ማዕከላት ለመቀየር እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ይህ አዲስ አገልግሎት ደንበኞች በማንኛውም የንግድ ባንክ ያላቸውን ሂሳብ በመጠቀም ገንዘብ እንዲያስቀምጡ፣ እንዲያወጡ እና የፍጆታ ክፍያዎችን እንዲፈጽሙ ያስችላቸዋል። ከኢትስዊች ጋር በመተባበር በ700 ቅርንጫፎች የጀመረው ይህ የሙከራ ፕሮጀክት በአንድ ወር ጊዜ ውስጥ ሙሉ በሙሉ ወደ ስራ እንደሚገባ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Itoophiyaa Phoostiin dameewwan isaa 3,000 ta'an gara giddu gala tajaajila baankii itti jijjiiruuf qophaa'aa jira. Tajaajilli kun maamiltooni baankiiwwan daldala biroo keessa jiran fayyadamuun maallaqa galchuuf, baasuuf akkasumas kaffaltii tajaajiloota adda addaa raawwachuuf isaan gargaara. Gamtaan dhaabbata poostichaa EthSwitch waliin ta'uun dameewwan 700 irratti qormaata jalqabe yoo ta'u, ji'a tokko keessatti biyyattii keessatti guutummaatti hojii irra oolchuuf karoorfateera.

title: Minister Threatens to Blacklist Traders Who Break Export Deals
english: The Ethiopian Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration is implementing strict penalties to address a record number of broken export contracts. Under this new plan, foreign buyers who default will be banned from trading with Ethiopia for one year, while local exporters face license suspensions or revocation. This initiative aims to protect the country's international reputation after years of disputes involving commodities like coffee and sesame.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ንግድና ቀጠናዊ ትስስር ሚኒስቴር የወጡ የኤክስፖርት ውሎችን ባለማክበር የሚፈጸሙ ህገወጥ ድርጊቶችን ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ጥብቅ እርምጃ ወስዷል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት ግዴታቸውን ያልተወጡ የውጭ ገዢዎች ለአንድ አመት ከኢትዮጵያ ጋር እንዳይነግዱ የሚታገዱ ሲሆን፣ የሀገር ውስጥ ላኪዎች ደግሞ የንግድ ፈቃዳቸው ሊታገድ ወይም ሊሰረዝ ይችላል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው እንደ ቡና እና ሰሊጥ ባሉ የግብርና ምርቶች ላይ የሚስተዋሉ የውል መዛባት የሀገሪቱን ገጽታ እየጎዳ በመምጣቱ ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Daldalaa fi Walitti Hidhamiinsa Naannawaa Itoophiyaa waliigaltee ergaa alaa cabsuu irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'eera. Karoora haaraa kanaan, bitattoonni biyya alaa waliigaltee cabsan waggaa tokkoof Itoophiyaa waliin daldaluu akka hin dandeenye kan dhorkaman yoo ta'u, ergaa alaa ergitoonni biyya keessaas hayyama daldalaa isaanii akka dhaban ta'a. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame akka bunaa fi samitaa kan jiran oomishalee qonnaa irratti rakkoo uumamee fi maqaa biyyaa miidhu hir'isuufi.

title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
english: A Ukrainian diver has been detained in Croatia due to his alleged involvement in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. German prosecutors claim the man helped plant explosives on the undersea infrastructure using a rented yacht. This arrest follows previous legal efforts in Poland and Italy regarding other suspects connected to the sabotage, as authorities seek to hold individuals accountable for the major energy infrastructure attack.

The group claims to have already targeted numerous oil vessels and military sites, warning that any further Saudi aggression will lead to a broader conflict. They are demanding that Riyadh end its military involvement, withdraw foreign troops, and allow Yemen to control its own natural resources.

title: Prosecutors Charge Seven Alleging Amhara Bank’s Credit Controls Bend for One Borrower
english: Federal prosecutors have charged five former Amhara Bank executives, along with Zemera Investment Group and its manager, for allegedly mismanaging bank funds. The group is accused of bypassing standard credit procedures to provide improper financial benefits to the investment firm, resulting in a loss of over 137 million Birr. The case centers on the illegal handling of import finance documents and the conversion of liabilities into unauthorized loans without proper collateral or risk analysis.

oromo: Abbaan alangaa federaalaa qondaaltota baankii Amaaraa duraanii shan fi garee invastimantii Zemeraa dabalatee namoota torba irratti himata banee jira. title: Israel numbers Palestinian detainee foreheads: What we know
english: Israeli soldiers recently marked a Palestinian detainee with a number on his forehead during a military operation in the West Bank town of Qabatiya. This incident has drawn significant criticism, as released detainees described the practice as a form of psychological intimidation and terror.

title: Second Ukrainian national arrested over 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blast
english: A second Ukrainian national has been arrested in Croatia and faces extradition to Germany for his alleged role in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions. German prosecutors identify the man as a trained diver who worked under the direction of an ex-army officer already facing charges for the same incident. This investigation aims to clarify the sabotage that damaged key gas supply routes between Russia and Europe.

title: Premier League 2026-27 form guide: Title race, prediction, players to watch
english: Following their successful title win last season, Arsenal enters the 2026-27 Premier League campaign as the team to beat by strengthening their already solid roster with new signings like Bruno Guimaraes. While Manchester City faces a transition period following Pep Guardiola's departure, other major clubs like Manchester United, Liverpool, and Chelsea are reorganizing to challenge for the championship. title: Israel’s Ben Gvir boasts of planned execution facility for Palestinian prisoners
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has announced the construction of a facility specifically designed to execute Palestinian prisoners through hanging. This project aligns with a controversial law passed by the Knesset that permits the death penalty for Palestinians convicted of deadly attacks. The plan includes viewing areas for victims' families, a move that has drawn sharp international criticism for being discriminatory and dehumanizing.

title: UK jury fails to convict activists over direct action at Israeli arms factory
english: A jury in the UK was unable to reach a verdict for eight activists accused of participating in a protest at an Israeli-linked arms factory in Bristol. The defendants were charged with property damage and violent behavior, although none of them actually entered the facility during the demonstration. Prosecutors are currently considering whether to pursue a new trial for the unresolved charges.

title: Foreign interference is real - but the UK should look beyond the usual culprits
english: The UK government has officially identified foreign interference as a major national security threat, primarily focusing on rivals like Russia and China. However, recent reviews suggest that influence campaigns also originate from allied nations and private groups, including actors linked to the United States and Israel. Critics argue that the government ignores these sources of political influence while strictly monitoring traditional adversaries, leading to calls for a more balanced approach to investigating external pressure on British democracy.

Mootummaan gareewwan kanneen duubatti dhiisee diinota isaa qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuu isaa qaawwa jiru jedhamee kan qeequ yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa alaa irratti qorannoo haqa qabeessa ta'e akka taasisu gaafatamaniiru.

title: 'Playing with fire': Israel's Syria strike tests Turkey after Mecca defence pact
english: Israel recently conducted airstrikes on the Abu al-Duhur military base in Syria, shortly after Turkey signed a new defense agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. While Israel claims the move was to prevent a security breach involving Turkish forces, Turkish officials dismiss the attack as a political tactic by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The incident has increased tensions, as Turkey denies having a military presence at the site and criticizes Israel for failing to communicate through established safety channels.

Israa'el tarkaanfichii kan fudhatame loltoonni Turkey bakka sana akka hin qabanneef jecha akka ta'e dubbattee jirti; garuu mootummaan Turkey haleellaan kun mala siyaasaa kan muummicha ministeeraa Benjamin Netanyahu ta'uu ibsuun balaaleeffatteetti. title: US seeking ‘honourable exit’ as regional influence fades, says Iran
english: The speaker of Iran's parliament claims that foreign influence in the Middle East is weakening as a new regional order emerges. He attributed this change to the sacrifice of two commanders killed by the US in 2020. According to him, the United States is now attempting to withdraw from the region while Israel's regional ambitions are failing.

english: Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho stated that his team does not require newly signed Barcelona player Rodri, despite admitting the club previously attempted to recruit him. english: The delivery of humanitarian aid in Gaza is severely hindered by a critical shortage of functional vehicles and spare parts due to the ongoing conflict. Many trucks have been destroyed or damaged, and those still operating struggle with lack of fuel and mechanical supplies. Furthermore, drivers face immense risks while navigating through damaged infrastructure and blockades, making it nearly impossible to distribute essential supplies to those in need.

title: Palestinian factions explore broad alliance for November elections
english: Major Palestinian political groups, led by Hamas and including various breakaway factions, are currently negotiating the formation of a unified electoral coalition ahead of the upcoming November legislative elections. This move aims to challenge President Mahmoud Abbas's Fatah party, which intends to run in the vote independently. Despite significant obstacles posed by ongoing regional conflict and political tensions, the factions view these historic polls as an essential exercise of their democratic rights.

Rakkoolee naannichatti jiran hunda keessa darbuudhaan, gareewwan kunneen filannoon kun mirga isaanii kan dimookiraasii akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Israeli army orders criminal investigation into killing of Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza
english: The Israeli military has launched a criminal investigation into the 2024 killing of five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza. This move follows reports that the young girl and her family were killed by Israeli fire while attempting to escape. An ambulance crew sent to rescue Hind was also struck and killed during the incident, which the military is now investigating due to failures in movement coordination.

title: Dozens killed after gold mine collapse in Central African Republic
english: A tragic gold mine collapse in the Central African Republic near the Cameroon border has resulted in the deaths of at least 30 people, with officials warning the final toll may be even higher. Rescue teams and local volunteers are currently searching the site to locate those still trapped under the debris. These types of accidents occur frequently in the region due to a lack of safety regulations and oversight in small-scale mining operations.

title: UAE trade embargo could shut Iran’s key economic escape route: Here’s why
english: The United Arab Emirates has imposed an indefinite trade and financial embargo on Iran following accusations that Iranian forces launched ballistic missiles into Emirati territory. Although Iran denies these claims and labels them as a provocation, analysts believe the ban will significantly impact Tehran because it relies on the UAE for vital imports and financial connectivity. This development marks a major escalation in regional tensions, potentially cutting off a critical economic lifeline for the Iranian government.
amharic: የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬቶች የኢራን ኃይሎች በግዛታቸው ላይ የባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን ተኩሰዋል በሚል ክስ በኢራን ላይ ያልተወሰነ ጊዜ የንግድ እና የገንዘብ ማዕቀብ ጥለዋል። ኢራን ክሱን ውድቅ በማድረግ ድርጊቱን ቅስቀሳ ብትልም፣ ኢራን ለቁልፍ የገቢ ዕቃዎች እና የፋይናንስ መዳረሻዎች በኢምሬቶች ላይ የተመሰረተች በመሆኗ ማዕቀቡ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደሚያደርስባት ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን ውጥረት በእጅጉ የሚያባብስ ሲሆን ለኢራን መንግሥት አስፈላጊ የሆነውን የኢኮኖሚ መስመር ሊዘጋው ይችላል።
oromo: Emirates Araba Gamtoomni humnoonni Iraan kombiiwwan bala'ina guddaa qaban gara biyya isaanii gadi lakkisaniiru jechuun, daldalaa fi waliigaltee maallaqa irratti Iran irratti uggura cimaa kaa'eera. title: In Ukraine, forcible military recruitment efforts escalate into violence
english: Ukraine is facing growing controversy over its aggressive military mobilization tactics, often referred to as 'busification,' where men are forcibly detained on the streets and taken to recruitment centers. This practice has become increasingly common and abusive, leading to reports of corruption and violent confrontations between civilians and officers. Many individuals, including those with health conditions, are being conscripted against their will, sparking significant public concern regarding the methods used to replenish the front lines.

title: Pakistan challenges top court order to move Imran Khan to private hospital
english: The Pakistani government has formally requested a review of a Supreme Court decision that ordered former Prime Minister Imran Khan to be transferred to a private hospital for medical care. Officials argue that the court bypassed standard legal protocols and that prisoners should receive treatment at public facilities instead. While the court previously authorized specialized care and increased family communication for the 73-year-old leader, the government contends that these directives exceed normal prison regulations.

title: Palestinians condemn Israeli step to advance illegal E1 settlement plan
english: The Palestinian Authority has strongly criticized Israel's decision to move forward with a controversial settlement plan known as E1, which involves building over 1,200 new housing units in the occupied West Bank. Critics warn that this project will physically divide the West Bank and cut off East Jerusalem from Palestinian areas, effectively ending hopes for a two-state solution. By connecting existing settlements, the expansion seeks to consolidate Israeli control over the region and further marginalize the Palestinian population.

oromo: Mootummaan Paalastayinii Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa West Baankii keessatti mana jireenyaa 1,200 oliin ijaaruuf karoorri 'E1' jedhamu akka itti fufu murteessuu ishee balaaleffateera. title: China’s Unitree soars in market debut as investors bet on humanoid robots
english: Chinese robotics firm Unitree Robotics experienced a massive surge during its Shanghai stock market debut, with share prices jumping by over 600 percent. The company is now recognized as a major leader in the humanoid robotics industry, having successfully sold thousands of units globally. This successful listing highlights significant investor confidence in China's growing ability to produce advanced, commercially viable human-like robots.
amharic: የቻይናው የሮቦቲክስ ኩባንያ ዩኒትሪ በሻንጋይ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ባደረገው የመጀመሪያ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ የአክሲዮን ዋጋው ከ600 በመቶ በላይ በማደግ ከፍተኛ ተቀባይነት አግኝቷል። ኩባንያው በዓለም ዙሪያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰብአዊ መልክ ያላቸው ሮቦቶችን በመሸጥ በዘርፉ ግንባር ቀደም መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። ይህ የገበያ ስኬት ባለሀብቶች ቻይና የላቁ እና ለንግድ አገልግሎት የሚውሉ ሮቦቶችን በማምረት ረገድ ያላትን አቅም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ እንደሚያምኑበት ያሳያል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teknooloojii Chaayinaa Unitree Robotics gabaa akshinii Shaanghaay irratti yeroo jalqabaaf dhiyaatetti gatiin akshinii isaa dhibbeentaa 600 ol dabaleera. Dhaabbatichi hanga ammaatti addunyaa maratti roobootii nama fakkaatan kumaan lakkaa'aman gurguruun damee kana keessatti hogganaa ta'uu isaa mirkaneesseera. Milkaa'inni gabaa kun, abdii guddaa invastaroonni dandeettii Chaayinaa kan roobootii ammayyaa oomishuuf qabdu irratti qaban kan calaqqisiisuudha.

title: Angelique Kidjo makes history with Hollywood walk of fame star
english: Renowned Beninese singer Angelique Kidjo has become the first Black African artist to be honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. This recognition celebrates her impressive 40-year career in music and her significant contributions to fostering global cultural exchange. The five-time Grammy Award winner was acknowledged for her dedication to bridging communities through her artistic work.
amharic: የቤኒኑ የሙዚቃ ኮከብ አንጀሊክ kidjo በሆሊውድ የእግር ጉዞ ኮከብ (Hollywood Walk of Fame) ላይ ኮከብ የተቀበለች የመጀመሪያዋ ጥቁር አፍሪካዊት አርቲስት በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርታለች። ይህ ክብር የአርባ ዓመት የሙዚቃ ጉዞዋን እና በሙዚቃ አማካይነት ባህሎችን በማቀራረብ ያበረከተችውን አስተዋጽኦ ያመላክታል። አምስት ጊዜ የግራሚ ሽልማትን ያገኘችው አርቲስቷ ለሙዚቃ ስራዎቿ ከፍተኛ እውቅና ተሰጥቷታል።
oromo: Weellistuun beekamtuu biyya Beenin Anjelik Kijo, Hollywood Walk of Fame irratti urjii argachuun seenaa hojjettee jirti. Ispoortii ykn aartii kana irratti urjii kanaan kan badhaafamte, artistii Afrikaa gurraattii jalqabaa taateetti. Badhaasni kun guddina hojii ishee waggoota afurtamaa fi muuziqaan aadaalee addunyaa walitti fiduuf tattaaffii gooteef kan kennamedha.

title: After three years apart, a Gaza father returns to his wife - and six death certificates
english: After being separated from his family for nearly three years due to border closures and his detention, Ahmed al-Siqali has finally returned to Gaza. He suffered through long-term displacement and imprisonment, only to return home to the tragic news that six of his children were killed in an Israeli airstrike in late 2023. He now carries their death certificates, mourning the loss of the children he was working to support before the war began.
amharic: አህመድ አል-ሲቃሊ ድንበር በመዘጋቱ እና በእስር በመቆየቱ ለሦስት ዓመታት ያህል ከቤተሰቡ ተለይቶ ከቆየ በኋላ ወደ ጋዛ ተመልሷል። ረጅም ጊዜ የፈጀ መፈናቀልንና እስርን ካሳለፈ በኋላ፣ ወደ ቤቱ ሲመለስ ስድስት ልጆቹ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 መጨረሻ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መገደላቸውን በመስማት በከፍተኛ ሀዘን ላይ ይገኛል። አሁን የልጆቹን ሞት ማረጋገጫ ወረቀቶች በእጁ ይዞ፣ ጦርነቱ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ለወደፊታቸው ሲጥር የነበረውን ልጆቹን በማጣቱ ጥልቅ ሐዘን ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Ahmed al-Siqali erga waggaa sadii guutuu cufiinsa daangaa fi hidhaan maatii isaa irraa adda ba'ee booda gara Gaazaatti deebi'eera. Godaansaa fi hidhaa dheeraa erga dabarseen booda, gara manaatti yeroo deebi'u ijoolleen isaa jahan dhuma bara 2023 haleellaa qilleensa irraa Israa'elidhaan ajjeefamuu isaanii hubateera. Amma waraqaa ragaa du'aa ijoollee isaa qabatee, waraanni osoo hin jalqabin dura guddina isaaniif hojjetaa ture sana dhabuu isaatti gadda guddaa keessa jira.

title: Iraq seeks special status for oil exports through Strait of Hormuz
english: The Iraqi parliament speaker has requested special protections for his country's oil shipments as they travel through the Strait of Hormuz. During a meeting in Baghdad with his Iranian counterpart, he expressed concerns about the safety of this vital maritime route amidst rising regional instability. This move underscores Iraq's vulnerability, as a significant portion of its oil exports relies on this path to reach global markets.
amharic: የኢራቅ ፓርላማ አፈ ጉባኤ የሀገሪቱን የነዳጅ ምርቶች በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ሲጓጓዙ ልዩ ጥበቃ እንዲደረግላቸው ጠይቀዋል። በባግዳድ ከኢራን አቻቸው ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በቀጠናው እየጨመረ የመጣው አለመረጋጋት ለነዳጅ መጓጓዣ መንገዱ ደህንነት ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የኢራቅ የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርት በአብዛኛው በዚህ የባህር መስመር ላይ የተመሰረተ በመሆኑ፣ ለሀገሪቱ የኢኮኖሚ ደህንነት ያለውን ወሳኝነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree biyyattii Iraaq, oomisha boba'aa biyyattii galaana Hormuz keessa yeroo darbuutti eegumsi addaa akka taasifamuuf gaafataniiru. Bagdaaditti hoggantoota Iraan waliin marii taasisaniin, walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa boba'aan gara gabaa addunyaatti ittiin darbuuf yaaddoo ta'uu ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kunis, oomishni boba'aa Iraaq hedduun daandii galaana kana irratti waan hirkatuuf, nageenya boba'aa ishee eeguuf kan yaadameedha.

title: Humanitarianism is not collapsing. It is being traded and compromised
english: International humanitarian principles are currently being undermined as governments prioritize political interests over universal laws. This shift has turned the protection of civilians and aid workers into a bargaining chip rather than a non-negotiable obligation. Consequently, impunity is rising and attacks on humanitarian personnel have surged, creating a dangerous environment for those providing essential aid.
amharic: መንግስታት ከዓለም አቀፍ ህግጋት ይልቅ የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ጥቅም በማስቀደማቸው ዓለም አቀፍ የሰብአዊ መብት መርሆዎች እየተሸረሸሩ ነው። የሲቪሎች እና የረድኤት ሰራተኞች ደህንነት እንደ ግዴታ ከመታየት ይልቅ ለድርድር የሚቀርብ የፖለቲካ መሳሪያ ሆኗል። በዚህም ምክንያት ተጠያቂነት የሌለው ድርጊት እየተስፋፋ ሲሆን በረድኤት ሰራተኞች ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Mootummoonni seera idil-addunyaa irratti faayidaa siyaasaa isaanii dursuu irraan kan ka'e, sirni namummaa fi gargaarsaa akka laafatu ta'eera. Eegumsi siivilootaa fi hojjettoota gargaarsaa dirqama idil-addunyaa ta'uu irraa gara meeshaa siyaasaatti jijjiirameera. Kanaanis, seera cabsuun babal'atee hojjettoonni gargaarsaa miidhaan gara jabinaa irra ga'uun isaanii dabaleera.

title: ‘Tit for tat’: Why is Trump cozying up to North Korea’s Kim Jong Un again?
english: President Trump is seeking to restart diplomatic talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, recently scaling back military drills with South Korea in a gesture of goodwill. Analysts believe this move is a strategic attempt to boost his political profile ahead of upcoming elections while also pressuring Seoul for greater cooperation on other global issues. By balancing these relationships, Trump is using a transactional approach to secure domestic political gains and leverage his alliances.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከሰሜን ኮሪያው መሪ ኪም ጆንግ ኡን ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነታቸውን እንደገና ለመጀመር እየሞከሩ ሲሆን፣ ለዚህም እንደ መነሻ ከደቡብ ኮሪያ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን ወታደራዊ ልምምድ ቀንሰዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚገልጹት ይህ አካሄድ በምርጫ ወቅት የፖለቲካ ተቀባይነትን ለማግኘት እና በሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮች ላይ ደቡብ ኮሪያ በበለጠ እንድትተባበር ግፊት ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው። ትራምፕ በዚህ የግብይት ዓይነት ዲፕሎማሲ ተጠቅመው የራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ ትርፍ ለማስገኘት እና ጥምረቶቻቸውን እንደ መጠቀሚያ እየተጠቀሙበት ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp hogganaa Koriyaa Kaabaa Kim Jong Un waliin hariiroo diippiloomaasii irra deebi'anii jalqabuuf yaalaa jiru, kanaafis akka mallattoo gaariitti leenjii waraanaa Koriyaa Kibbaa waliin taasisan hir'isaniiru. Xiinxaltoonni akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun filannoo dhiyaate dursee sadarkaa siyaasummaa isaanii ol kaasuuf fi dhimmoota biroo irratti Koriyaan Kibbaa akka isaan waliin hojjattu dhiibbaa gochuuf kan yaadame dha. Traamp tooftaa diippiloomaasii gabaa fakkaatu kanaan fayyadamuun, faayidaa siyaasaa ofii isaanii fi hariiroo biyyoota biraa itti fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
english: Authorities in Nevada have discovered human remains at Lake Mead after visitors spotted bones along the shoreline. The incident follows a severe, long-term drought that has caused the water levels in the nation's largest reservoir to reach record lows. Investigations are currently ongoing to identify the remains as the receding water continues to reveal items previously hidden underwater.
amharic: በኔቫዳ በሚገኘው የሊክ ሚድ ግድብ የውኃ መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመቀነሱ የሰው አጽም መገኘቱን ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግኝት የተከሰተው በክልሉ በተከሰተው ድርቅ ምክንያት የውኃው መጠን ከወትሮው ዝቅተኛ በመሆኑ ነው። በአሁኑ ሰዓት የህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ጉዳዩን እያጣሩ ሲሆን፣ የወረደው የውኃ መጠን ከዚህ ቀደም በውኃ ውስጥ የነበሩ ነገሮች እንዲጋለጡ እያደረገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni naannoo Nevaadaa, sadarkaan bishaan haroo 'Lake Mead' gadi bu'uu isaatiin walqabatee lafeen namaa bakka sanatti argamuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Hir'inni bishaanii kun kan uumame goginsa cimaa waggoota dheeraaf tureen yoo ta'u, kunis lafeewwan yeroo dheeraaf bishaan jala turan akka mul'atan taasiseera. Poolisiin naannichaa qorannoo isaa itti fufaa jira.

title: Top India court allows passive euthanasia, but few aware of ‘living wills’
english: Although India's top court has legalized passive euthanasia, most citizens remain uninformed about the legal process for creating 'living wills' to manage end-of-life care. Many families of terminally ill patients struggle to access palliative support or understand how to advocate for their loved ones' dignity when medical treatments are no longer effective. Consequently, these families often face severe distress and confusion due to a lack of institutional guidance and awareness regarding terminal care options.
amharic: የህንድ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት በተዘዋዋሪ መንገድ ለሚፈጸም የሞት ፍቃድ (passive euthanasia) እውቅና ቢሰጥም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ዜጎች ህይወታቸው አልፎ ህክምና በማይጠቅምበት ጊዜ ስለሚወሰዱ ውሳኔዎች (living wills) በቂ ግንዛቤ የላቸውም። ተርሚናል በሆኑ ህመሞች የተያዙ ታካሚ ቤተሰቦች ተገቢውን የህመም ማስታገሻ ድጋፍ ለማግኘት ወይም የሚወዷቸውን ሰዎች ክብር ለመጠበቅ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው ይቸገራሉ። በዚህም ምክንያት ተቋማዊ መረጃ ባለመኖሩ ቤተሰቦች ከፍተኛ የጭንቀት እና የመደናገር ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይወድቃሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Hindii biyyattii keessatti namoonni lubbuun isaanii daangaa irra gahe akka du'an hayyamuuf (passive euthanasia) seera baasee kan jiru ta'us, lammiileen hedduun waa'ee 'living wills' ykn fedhii du'aa duraa irratti hubannoo gahaa hin qaban. Maatiin dhukkubsattoota fayyuu hin dandeenye hedduun, tajaajila dhukkubbiin itti salphatu argachuuf ykn yeroo qorichi hin hojjennetti kabajamanii du'uuf maal gochuu akka qaban hin beekan. Dhabamuu odeeffannoo fi gorsa gahaa irraa kan ka'e, maatiin dhukkubsattootaa kun yaaddoo fi wal-dadhabbiin guddaa keessa galu.

title: NATO responds to alleged report that Iran considered targeting US forces in Europe
english: NATO has affirmed its commitment to protecting its member states following reports that Iran might target American military bases in Europe in response to potential US aggression. Alliance officials emphasized that their defense systems are highly capable, citing successful past instances where they neutralized threats from Iranian missiles. The organization remains prepared to take all required measures to ensure the security of its members.
amharic: ኢራን በአውሮፓ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ጥቃት ልትሰነዝር እንደምትችል በወጡ ዘገባዎች ተከትሎ፣ ኔቶ የአባል ሀገራቱን ለመጠበቅ ዝግጁ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። የድርጅቱ አመራሮች ቀደም ሲል ከኢራን የተተኮሱ ሚሳይሎችን በመከላከል አቅማቸውን እንዳሳዩ በመግለጽ፣ አባል ሀገራቱን ከማንኛውም ስጋት ለመከላከል አስፈላጊውን እርምጃ ሁሉ እንደሚወስዱ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Iraan weerara Ameerikaa jala madaquun buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kanneen Awurooppaa keessa jiran irratti haleellaa raawwachuu dandeessi jedhamee gabaasamee booda, NATO biyyoota miseensa isaa ittisuuf qophiidha jedhe. Hoggantoonni gamtaa kanaa, kanaan dura rakkoolee fagootti gahuu danda'an ittisuu keessatti dandeettii isaanii agarsiisaniiru; akkasumas miseensota isaanii eeguuf tarkaanfii kamiyyuu fudhachuuf akka qophaayan ibsaniiru.

title: US envoy says Israeli attack risked direct confrontation with Turkey
english: A US envoy has warned that a recent Israeli airstrike on a Syrian airbase nearly caused a military conflict with Turkey. Because Turkish forces were not notified of the operation, they could have mistaken the Israeli jets for a threat and launched their own aircraft in response. Although the situation did not escalate into a fight, officials expressed significant concern over the danger posed by the lack of communication.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት በቅርቡ እስራኤል በሶሪያ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የፈፀመችው ጥቃት ከቱርክ ጋር ወታደራዊ ግጭት ሊፈጥር እንደነበር አስጠንቅቀዋል። ቱርክ ስለ ጥቃቱ ቀድሞ ማሳወቂያ ስላልተሰጣት፣ የእስራኤልን የጦር አውሮፕላኖች እንደ ስጋት በመቁጠር የራሷን ጄቶች ለማስነሳት ተገዳ ሊሆን ይችል ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ግጭቱ ባይቀጥልም፣ ባለስልጣናት ይህ ድርጊት የፈጠረውን የደህንነት ስጋት በእጅጉ ነቅፈዋል።
oromo: Hojjetan mootummaa Ameerikaa tokko akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin Israa’el buufata xiyyaaraa Suuriyaa irratti fudhatte waraana kallattii biyyattii fi Turkii gidduutti kaasuu danda’ee ture. Turkii tarkaanfichaan dura waan hin beekneef, xiyyaarota Israa’el akka diinaatti ilaaluun of ittisuuf xiyyaarota ishee kaasuuf dirqamtee turte. Haalli kun gara walitti bu’iinsaatti kan hin jijjiiramne ta’us, qaamoleen kun walhubannoo dhabuun kun balaa guddaa akka qabu ibsaniiru.

title: ‘Permanently damaged her’: Israel’s starvation of Gaza leaves children stunted
english: Six-year-old Amira Rashid from Gaza is suffering from severe malnutrition due to the ongoing conflict and lack of food access. Her physical and mental development has been permanently impaired, preventing her from starting school as planned. This tragic case highlights the long-term impact of starvation on children living in the region.
amharic: በጋዛ የምትገኘው የስድስት ዓመቷ አሚራ ራሺድ አሁን ባለው ግጭት እና የምግብ እጥረት ሳቢያ ለከፍተኛ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጦት ተጋልጣለች። የልጅቷ የአካል እና የአእምሮ እድገት ላይ ዘላቂ ጉዳት በመድረሱ፣ እንደታቀደው ወደ ትምህርት ቤት መግባት አልቻለችም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጋዛ የሚገኙ ህጻናት በረሃብ ምክንያት እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን ከባድ ቀውስ ያሳያል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti mucayyoon umuriinshee waggaa jahaa Amira Raashid jedhamtu, waraanaa fi rakkoo nyaataa irraa kan ka'e fayyaan ishee hanga kana miidhameera. Guddinnii qaamaa fi sammuushee waan miidhameef, akka karoorfatte gara mana barumsaa deemuuf hin dandeenye. Dhimmisi kun miidhaa hamaa ijoolleen Gaza keessa jiran beelaan irra gahaa jiru ifa godha.

title: Manav Suthar takes 10-wicket haul as India beat Sri Lanka in 600th Test
english: India secured a 165-run victory over Sri Lanka in their landmark 600th Test match held in Galle. Young spinner Manav Suthar was the standout performer, claiming a total of 10 wickets throughout the game to lead his team to a 1-0 series lead. Despite some resistance from the Sri Lankan middle order, the hosts were bowled out for 206 runs on the final day.
amharic: ህንድ በጋሌ በተካሄደው 600ኛው የቴስት ጨዋታዋ በስሪ ላንካ ላይ በ165 ሩጫዎች አሸንፋለች። የግራ እጅ ስፒነሩ ማናቭ ሱታር በአጠቃላይ 10 ውኬቶችን በመውሰድ ለቡድኑ ድል ቁልፍ ሚና ተጫውቷል። የስሪ ላንካ ተጫዋቾች ተቃውሞ ለማድረግ ቢሞክሩም፣ በመጨረሻው ቀን በ206 ሩጫዎች ተሸንፈው ህንድ በተከታታይ ሁለት ጨዋታዎች በሚደረገው የቴስት ውድድር 1-0 መምራት ጀምራለች።
oromo: Indiyaan tapha ishee 600ffaa kan ta'e 'Test' irratti biyya Sri Laankaa 165n injifatteetti. Isppinarri dargaggeessi Maanaav Sutaar taphicha guutuu keessatti wikeetii 10 fudhachuun injifannoo kanaaf gahee guddaa taphateera. Hoggantoonni Sri Laankaa mormii cimaa agarsiisuuf yaalanis, guyyaa dhumaa irratti 206 qofa galchuun Indiyaan sadarkaa 1-0 irra akka qaqqabdu taasiseera.
